The company, which recently rebranded, aims to re-enter the public stock market, having transformed from a competitor to a partner of public cloud giants. Rackspace reported $2.44 billion in revenue in 2019 with a net loss of $102.3 million.

title: American Century Sustainable Equity ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:ESGA)
summary: The American Century Sustainable Equity ETF (ESGA) is an actively managed, non-transparent ETF that screens US companies using fundamental measures and ESG metrics. Launched on July 13, 2020, ESGA had assets under management of $238.68 million and a net expense ratio of 0.39% as of the article's last update. The fund's top holdings include major tech companies like Microsoft, Apple, NVIDIA, and Alphabet.

title: LivePerson CEO Rob LoCascio explains how personal tragedy led his company to abandon the office
summary: LivePerson CEO Rob LoCascio announced that the company is transitioning to a fully remote work model, closing all 17 global offices. This decision was influenced by the tragic loss of an employee to Covid-19, which underscored the need to prioritize employee safety and comfort. The move also allows the company to reallocate its $12 million annual office space budget, offering greater flexibility and a broader talent pool.

title: Google announces $10bn investment in 'digital India'
summary: Google has announced a $10 billion investment in India over the next five to seven years through its Google for India Digitisation Fund. This funding aims to boost India's digital infrastructure, help businesses go digital, and leverage technology for social good, reflecting Google's confidence in the country's growing digital economy. The investment comes shortly after India banned several Chinese apps, creating a potential void for Silicon Valley giants to fill.

title: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Funding: UiPath Reaches $10B Valuation
summary: UiPath, a robotic process automation (RPA) software startup, has secured $225 million in Series E funding, pushing its post-money valuation to $10.2 billion. This funding round is likely a precursor to a potential IPO, as the company continues to experience rapid growth, with annual recurring revenue reaching $400 million. The company plans to use the new capital to deepen investments in R&D for its hyperautomation platform and expand AI-powered innovation and cloud offerings.

title: Independent Research Firm Cites Rackspace Technology as a Leader in Hosted Private Cloud Services in North America and Europe
summary: Rackspace Technology has been recognized as a leader in hosted private cloud services in both North America and Europe by an independent research firm, The Forrester Wave™. The reports highlight Rackspace's platform breadth, strong reputation for support, "Fanatical Support" philosophy, and innovation in managed services. Rackspace is considered a solid choice for both enterprise and SMB customers looking for hosted private cloud solutions.

title: Is the Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund the Best Way to Invest in Tech?
summary: The Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLK) is a popular ETF for tech exposure but may not be the most diversified option. Despite low operating expenses, XLK has a concentrated allocation with over 43% in Microsoft and Apple, covering only 71 companies. The PowerShares QQQ Trust (QQQ) offers broader diversification across 100 tech-focused names, providing a more balanced alternative even with a slightly higher expense ratio.

title: Google to launch 3 more tech certificates on Coursera
summary: Google is launching three new tech certificates on Coursera in data analytics, project management, and user experience design, costing $49 a month and taking three to six months to complete. These certificates aim to help workers affected by the coronavirus pandemic find jobs, with Google funding 100,000 need-based scholarships and considering completion equivalent to a four-year degree for relevant internal roles. This initiative expands on Google's existing IT support certificate program and includes plans for a hiring consortium, apprenticeships, and integration into high schools and community colleges.

title: Office Depot parent names former Amazon exec CTO
summary: The ODP Corporation, parent company of OfficeMax and Office Depot, has appointed Terry Leeper, a former Amazon executive, as its new executive vice president and chief technology officer. Leeper will focus on the company's technical strategy and modernization to support growth. This appointment is part of a trend among retailers to bolster their tech leadership as the industry shifts towards online operations, especially in light of the coronavirus pandemic.

title: Microsoft Adds Rick Wagner as Corporate VP
summary: Former ManTech executive Rick Wagner has joined Microsoft as the new corporate vice president of Microsoft Federal. In this role, he will support federal agencies in mission-critical work, digital transformations, and technology engagement. Wagner brings over 30 years of industry experience, including previous roles at the Defense Department and ManTech.

title: Equinix to build fourth Italian data center in Milan
summary: Equinix is constructing its fourth data center in Milan, Italy, named ML5, with an initial investment of about $51 million for its first phase. Set to launch early next year, ML5 will offer 15,000 sq ft of colocation space initially, expanding to 45,000 sq ft in total. The facility will be powered by 100 percent renewable energy and serve as a strategic interconnection point for Italian and international companies.

title: Top 5 Predictions for the Global Healthcare Industry Post COVID-19
summary: A Frost & Sullivan report, "Post-Pandemic Global Healthcare Market Outlook, 2020," predicts a significant drop in healthcare industry growth in 2020 due to COVID-19, with medical technologies and imaging being hit hardest, while digital health thrives. The report outlines five key predictions including the mainstreaming of telehealth, growth in AI solutions for workflow automation, a redefinition of critical care models, the rise of point-of-care testing in pharmacies, and disruptions to clinical trials leading to virtual alternatives. These trends highlight a transformative year for healthcare, marked by reallocated budgets, technological adoption, and evolving care delivery models.

title: Barr condemns Disney and Hollywood for 'kowtowing' to China | William Barr
summary: US Attorney General William Barr criticized Disney and other Hollywood studios for allegedly "kowtowing" to the Chinese Communist Party, accusing them of prioritizing short-term profits over American values. Barr highlighted instances where Disney reportedly apologized for a film about the Dalai Lama and allowed Chinese officials a role in Shanghai Disneyland, while Hollywood studios allegedly tweaked scripts to appease Beijing. He also extended his criticism to US technology companies, calling them "pawns of Chinese influence" for their operations in China.

title: Invest in companies with strong and sustainable moat
summary: This article explains the concept of an economic moat, coined by Warren Buffett, which refers to a company's sustainable competitive advantage. It discusses how to identify such companies through strong brands, long-term profitability growth, high switching costs for customers, and low production costs. The author advocates investing in these "moat companies" for long-term wealth creation, providing examples like Colgate Palmolive and Nestle India with their financials.

title: How Software-as-a-Service Can Optimize Patient Care Delivery
summary: The article discusses how Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) significantly optimizes patient care delivery by providing healthcare organizations with advanced digital tools and data analytics without the burden of in-house infrastructure. SaaS addresses critical issues like data security, clinician usability, and fiscal certainty by offering scalable solutions, continuous optimization, and fixed subscription costs. This approach allows hospitals to focus on patient care while benefiting from cutting-edge technology and insights from a vast array of patient data.

title: Halliburton Forms Strategic Agreement With Microsoft and Accenture to Advance Digital Capabilities
summary: Halliburton has entered into a five-year strategic agreement with Microsoft and Accenture to enhance its digital capabilities by migrating to Microsoft Azure. This collaboration aims to improve Halliburton's real-time operations, analytics using machine learning and AI, and the deployment of new technologies, while also moving all physical data centers to the cloud. The migration is expected to be completed by 2022, leveraging Accenture's expertise in cloud transformation.

title: Halliburton to close its data centers, move to Microsoft Azure cloud
summary: Halliburton, one of the world's largest oil field service companies, is partnering with Accenture and Microsoft Azure for a five-year strategic agreement to migrate its data centers to the cloud by 2022. The move aims to enhance digital capabilities, drive business agility, and reduce capital expenditures, utilizing Microsoft Azure for storage, processing, real-time monitoring, and machine learning. This decision comes despite growing criticism of cloud companies' contracts with the oil and gas sector and Microsoft's own goal to be carbon negative by 2030.

title: Halliburton forms strategic agreement with Microsoft and Accenture to advance digital capabilities
summary: Halliburton, Microsoft, and Accenture have announced a five-year strategic agreement to advance Halliburton's digital capabilities in Microsoft Azure. This collaboration will involve migrating Halliburton's physical data centers to Azure, enhancing real-time operations, improving analytics with machine learning and AI, and accelerating new technology deployment. Accenture will facilitate the transition, leveraging its cloud migration framework.

title: Uber pledges to double company’s Black leadership by 2025
summary: Uber Technologies Inc. has pledged to double its Black leadership by 2025, joining other tech giants in setting measurable goals for racial and economic justice. The company will also implement anti-bias training, tie executive compensation to diversity metrics, and support Black-owned businesses. This initiative follows the company's 2019 diversity report, which showed Black leaders made up only 3.3% of those with a director title or higher, despite Black employees representing 9.3% of the total U.S. workforce.

title: Halliburton forms strategic agreement with Microsoft and Accenture to advance digital capabilities
summary: Halliburton has entered into a five-year strategic agreement with Microsoft and Accenture to enhance its digital capabilities in Microsoft Azure. This partnership aims to migrate all of Halliburton's physical data centers to Azure by 2022, driving increased business agility, reducing capital expenditures, and leveraging cloud services for sustainability benefits. Accenture will facilitate this transition, building on the long-standing relationships with both Halliburton and Microsoft.

title: 401 Years and Counting: The Story of Modern Slavery in America
summary: This article argues that the Thirteenth Amendment's exception for punishment for a crime allows modern slavery to persist legally in US prisons. It details how the private prison system, driven by profit, perpetuates racism through policies that target communities of color, leading to increased incarceration rates and the forced labor of prisoners for little to no wages. The author also highlights the significant financial investments made by various institutions, including universities and large corporations, in the Prison Industrial Complex (PIC), profiting from this system of oppression.

title: AWS and HSBC Reach Long-Term Strategic Cloud Agreement
summary: HSBC Holdings plc has selected Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a long-term strategic cloud provider to accelerate its digital transformation. This multi-year global agreement will see HSBC adopting AWS cloud services across its lines of business, starting with customer-facing applications and modernization efforts in its Global Wealth & Personal Banking segment. The collaboration aims to enable HSBC to innovate faster, enhance customer experiences through personalized banking services, and improve operational efficiency using AWS's compute, storage, analytics, and machine learning capabilities.

title: Online Gaming Market Next Big Thing | Major Giants Microsoft, NCSOFT, Sony
summary: A new research report titled "Online Gaming Market Global Online Gaming Market Research Report 2020 (Covid-19 Version)" has been released by HTF MI. The study evaluates the global online gaming market, identifying opportunities, risks, and strategic decision-making support. It provides insights into market trends, drivers, and the changing investment structure, profiling key players such as Activision Blizzard, Electronic Arts, Microsoft, NCSOFT, and Sony.

title: Big Tech Has a Big Climate Problem. Now, It’s Being Forced to Clean Up.
summary: Apple has pledged to make its devices carbon-neutral by 2030, joining other tech giants like Microsoft and Amazon in ramping up climate targets. The company plans to reduce emissions by 75% in its manufacturing chain through recycling and encouraging renewable energy use by suppliers, offsetting the remaining 25% with reforestation projects. These voluntary commitments come as big tech faces increasing pressure to address its own contribution to climate change.

title: Clear Channel Outdoor Integrates its Digital Displays with Place Exchange Offering Programmatic Buyers Brand Safety, Attribution & Transparency
summary: Clear Channel Outdoor (CCO) has integrated its digital Out-of-Home (OOH) displays with Place Exchange, a leading SSP for programmatic OOH media. This partnership allows digital media buyers to access CCO's inventory programmatically through omnichannel DSPs, facilitating brand safety, attribution, and transparency. The move aims to help marketers plan and measure campaigns against evolving consumer travel patterns, especially post-COVID-19.

title: Global digital and social media usage July 2020 — everything you need to know
summary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of global digital and social media usage in July 2020, highlighting increased digital activity due to the pandemic. Key findings include over half the world now using social media, evolving search behaviors with a rise in image recognition and social network influence, and the enduring impact of WFH and video conferencing. It also covers milestones for Instagram and LinkedIn, challenges for TikTok after an Indian ban, and sustained growth in e-commerce.

title: Vertex, which tracks sales taxes for firms around the world, plans to go public this year; $4M for ambulance firm Roundtrip
summary: Family-owned Vertex Inc., a company specializing in sales tax software, announced its plan to go public this year with an initial public offering aiming to raise up to $344 million. The Westphal family will retain control of voting shares post-IPO. Separately, Philadelphia-based ambulance firm Roundtrip secured $4 million in new capital to expand its operations.

title: CYBER ATTACK TRENDS: 2020 MID-YEAR REPORT
summary: This report details significant cyber attack trends observed in the first half of 2020, influenced by the global shift to online activities due to the pandemic. Key trends highlighted include the emergence of "Double Extortion" ransomware, increased nation-state cyber warfare, evolving mobile threats, and new vulnerabilities in cloud infrastructures like Microsoft Azure. The report emphasizes how cybercriminals adapted to the new remote work environment and targeted institutions involved in COVID-19 research.

title: New HP Managed Print Services Sold Direct -
summary: HP Inc. has launched new global Managed Print Cloud Services for enterprise and SMB customers, which will be sold directly, bypassing the channel. This initiative includes support for Microsoft 365's Universal Print and an enhanced online portal for remote workers to acquire printers and supplies. This direct sales approach comes shortly after HP announced its new Amplify partner program, set to go into effect for commercial partners on November 1, 2020.

title: Interoperable Process Design Kit (iPDK) support for 22FDX
summary: GLOBALFOUNDRIES (GF) has announced the release of OpenAccess iPDK libraries optimized for its 22FDX platform, which offers high performance, low power consumption, and broad feature integration for various applications. This open-standard based iPDK ensures interoperability and compatibility among different design tool suites. The move aims to provide clients with greater flexibility, reduce design costs, and foster value creation within the industry.

title: Lloyds bank buys into cloud-native payments
summary: Lloyds Banking Group is investing in and collaborating with fintech firm Form3 to develop a cloud-native payments as a service (PaaS) platform. This initiative is part of a £300m project aimed at modernizing its IT infrastructure, improving payment processes, and accelerating the development of new products and services. The bank's broader digital transformation strategy also includes significant deals with Google Cloud and Microsoft to enhance technology access, software development, and employee productivity.

title: GlobalData: Halliburton turns to cloud-based analytics and digital technologies as oil struggles to rebound
summary: Halliburton is focusing on cloud-based analytics and digital technologies to navigate the struggling oil market, particularly after significant revenue declines in North and Latin American markets. The company aims for $1 billion in cost reductions by improving efficiencies through digital investments, including a five-year agreement with Microsoft and Accenture. Despite these efforts and optimism, market uncertainty, scalability challenges, client adoption, and depressed global demand remain significant hurdles.

title: Work From Home ETF Already Impressing
summary: The Direxion Work From Home ETF (WFH) has quickly gained over $50 million in assets and shown strong performance since its launch. The fund invests in companies across four technology pillars related to remote work and is seen as a credible long-term investment. WFH's underlying index has a higher price-to-sales multiple than the S&P 500 but a discount to the Nasdaq-100, with strong forecasted earnings growth.

title: Pfizer Vaccine Deal, Microsoft's Strong Performance
summary: Pfizer announced a $1.95 billion deal with the U.S. government to deliver a coronavirus vaccine in 2021, causing its shares and BioNTech's shares to surge. Microsoft also reported strong fourth-quarter results, surpassing estimates with a 13% revenue increase, though net income decreased due to physical store closures. Tesla also beat Wall Street expectations for its second-quarter profits, with significant increases in cash and vehicle deliveries, and its stock continues to perform well.

title: Corning unveils Gorilla Glass Victus with enhanced drop, scratch resistance
summary: Corning has introduced Gorilla Glass Victus, a new version of its popular glass that offers significant improvements in both drop and scratch resistance compared to its predecessor, Gorilla Glass 6. Lab tests show Victus surviving 2-meter drops and handling an 8 Newton load in scratch tests. While Apple uses Gorilla Glass, Samsung will be the first to incorporate Victus into a new device.

title: Gold Is Within Striking Distance of Its All-Time High. Here’s How to Play the Rally
summary: The article discusses gold's rally, nearing its all-time high, driven by the ongoing pandemic, global stimulus packages, and the overvaluation of tech stocks. Author Frank Holmes suggests that the precious metal is in a secular bull market and recommends a 10% portfolio weighting in gold and precious metals. He also highlights the strong performance of precious metal miners and royalty/streaming companies.

title: What's Changed: 2020 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Center Backup and Recovery Solutions
summary: This article reviews the 2020 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Center Backup and Recovery Solutions, highlighting changes since the previous report. It evaluates eleven leading providers, categorizing them into niche players, visionaries, challengers, and leaders based on their ability to execute and completeness of vision. The report details key advancements and positions of companies like Acronis, Actifio, Arcserve, Cohesity, Commvault, Dell Technologies, IBM, Rubrik, Unitrends, Veeam, and Veritas Technologies.

title: MSCI announces strategic alliance with Microsoft to accelerate innovation in the global investment industry
summary: MSCI Inc. and Microsoft Corp. have formed a strategic alliance to accelerate innovation within the global investment industry. This collaboration will initially focus on migrating MSCI's products, data, and services to Microsoft Azure, aiming to enhance client experience and operational efficiencies. The partnership also plans to explore joint efforts in climate risk and ESG solutions, leveraging both companies' expertise and platforms.

title: Banking on AI: RBC Builds a DGX-Powered Private Cloud
summary: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) has built an NVIDIA DGX-powered private cloud to enhance its AI capabilities and transform client experiences, leveraging a strategic investment in AI through its research institute, Borealis AI. This new infrastructure allows RBC to run thousands of simulations and analyze millions of data points rapidly, enabling the development of smart applications and significant savings in total cost of ownership. The initiative showcases RBC's commitment to innovation and its early adoption of emerging technologies to maintain its competitive edge in the financial services industry.

title: Next-generation search engines want to bring back our privacy
summary: CodeFuel's new private search engine, Privado, in partnership with Microsoft, aims to offer users true anonymity by encrypting keywords and hiding identities. This initiative comes as consumers, particularly younger generations, increasingly demand greater privacy from tech giants. Privado seeks to provide targeted advertising based only on current searches, without building user profiles, and plans to explore voice and image search in the future.

title: Meeting The Moment: HPE CEO Antonio Neri’s Year Of Extraordinary Leadership
summary: This article highlights HPE CEO Antonio Neri's leadership during a tumultuous year marked by the COVID-19 pandemic and social unrest. It details his commitment to partners, the acceleration of HPE's edge-to-cloud Platform-as-a-Service strategy with GreenLake, and his focus on the company's culture. Partners commend Neri's authentic leadership, his financial support for the channel, and his vision for the future of hybrid cloud.

title: Mark Vaupel Isn’t Letting a Pandemic Stop Transformation
summary: Mark Vaupel, VP of IT services at Hormel Foods, successfully led the company's "Project Orion," a comprehensive ERP overhaul, even amidst the COVID-19 pandemic. This transformation involved implementing cloud-based systems, redefining business processes, and enabling remote work for thousands of employees. The project, in collaboration with KPMG and Oracle, highlights Hormel Foods' ability to innovate and adapt to changing conditions.

title: Imax Workers' Early 'Tenet' Review: "Oh My God - I Forgot How Great It Was To Be In A Movie", CEO Relays
summary: Imax CEO Rich Gelfond shared early reactions from employees who saw Christopher Nolan's "Tenet," describing their overwhelming sense of joy at being in a movie theater again. The film, which was made with Imax equipment, is set to open internationally before its U.S. release with Imax expecting 90% of its global network to be open by August's end. Gelfond also discussed the safety protocols in place, emphasizing Imax's advantages over other venues in managing COVID-19 transmission riscos and addressed the Universal-AMC deal, stating it would not significantly impact Imax's business model.

title: Google Taps Dr Pepper, Spills Cloud Services, Pushes Edge With Orange
summary: Google Cloud has unveiled new services, a multi-year deal with Keurig Dr Pepper, and a partnership with Orange aimed at strengthening its position against Microsoft Azure. The new services focus on cloud migration and security, while the deal with Keurig Dr Pepper involves migrating their data centers to Google Cloud. The partnership with Orange will focus on 5G, mobile edge computing, and AI to develop new business services in Europe.

title: SPDR S&P 500 ESG ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:EFIV) $EFIV
summary: The SPDR S&P 500 ESG ETF (EFIV) tracks an ESG-screened, market-cap weighted index of S&P 500 stocks. Since its launch on July 27, 2020, the ETF's stock has increased by 10.3%, trading at $72.97 as of June 18, 2026. The fund has assets under management of $1.08 billion, a dividend yield of 0.92%, and a net expense ratio of 0.10%.

title: Nvidia sets 16 new performance records in latest MLPerf AI benchmarks
summary: Nvidia's latest A100 GPU and its DGX SuperPOD system achieved 16 new performance records in the third annual MLPerf benchmark tests, showcasing significant advancements in AI training. The company's hardware excelled in new recommendation systems tests, Natural Language Processing, and reinforcement learning. This performance highlights a four-times improvement over Nvidia's previous DGX system, reinforcing its position in the AI hardware market alongside other strong contenders like Google.

title: CyberArk launches open-source Shadow Admin identification tool for Azure and AWS
summary: CyberArk has released an open-source tool called SkyArk to identify "Shadow Admin" accounts in Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services environments. These accounts, often overlooked due to their indirect privilege assignments, pose a significant security risk as they can grant full administrative power to attackers. SkyArk features AzureStealth and AWStealth modules that require only read-only permissions to scan cloud entities and their assigned permissions, providing valuable insights for both red teams (offense) and blue teams (defense) to enhance security.

title: Apple smashes revenue estimates in record third quarter
summary: Apple significantly surpassed revenue expectations in its fiscal third quarter, reporting a record $59.7 billion, an 11% increase year-over-year. This surge was driven by increased demand for iPhones, iPads, and Mac computers as consumers adapted to working and learning from home during the pandemic. The company also announced a four-for-one stock split and confirmed a slight delay for the next iPhone launch.

title: Keith White – Puget Sound
summary: Keith White, SVP, GM, Hewlett Packard Enterprise GreenLake Cloud Services, was named a top Technology Disruptor by CRN in 2020 for his work in delivering an on-premises cloud experience that competes with major public cloud providers. White was handpicked by HPE's CEO to lead the company's GreenLake Cloud Services Business Group after spending over twenty years at Microsoft, where he significantly contributed to the growth of Microsoft Azure. He holds a bachelor's degree in business and economics from the University of Puget Sound.

title: Amdocs Buys Openet to Boost Cloud Credentials but Still Needs Broader Cloud Proposition
summary: Amdocs acquired Openet to enhance its 5G charging, policy, and cloud technologies, aiming to bolster its cloud-native credentials and diversify revenue. While the acquisition strengthens Amdocs' position with communications service providers, the company is advised to seek more robust multi-cloud platform technology, like Kubernetes suites, to address the evolving hybrid and multi-cloud landscape in 5G. This strategic move could position Amdocs as a pivotal broker between CSPs and hyperscalers, ensuring CSP independence and control.

title: Communist China puts our technology and safety at risk every day
summary: The article highlights the severe threat posed by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to U.S. technology and national security through cyberattacks, data theft, and intellectual property infringement. Authors Rep. Adam Kinzinger and Rep. John Joyce detail instances like "Operation Aurora" and the OPM breach, emphasize the dangers of applications like TikTok, and underscore the CCP's efforts to steal COVID-19 vaccine research. They advocate for congressional action, including proposals from the China Task Force, to bolster defenses, protect American research, and secure telecommunications against Chinese technological overreach to safeguard national security and human rights.

title: Move over Aramco, Apple is now world’s most valuable company
summary: Apple Inc. has surpassed Saudi Aramco to become the world's most valuable company, with its market capitalization reaching $1.817 trillion after a 10% jump on Friday. This shift comes as Apple has benefited from an accelerated move to digital services during the pandemic, while Aramco has faced challenges including a disappointing IPO and plunging crude prices. Apple's valuation now stands higher than Aramco's $1.76 trillion, highlighting the growing strength of tech companies amid global changes.

title: Adobe Experience Manager review
summary: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) is a high-end platform designed to streamline digital content management for large organizations, offering advanced features for websites, forms, and digital assets. While its significant licensing and setup costs might deter midsize businesses, its intuitive interface, AI-powered tools, and robust functionality make it an attractive solution for enterprise-level operations. The platform comprises AEM Sites, Forms, and Assets, all running on Adobe Cloud Service, providing comprehensive solutions for content creation, data collection, and asset management.

title: Corning Gorilla Glass Victus: Next-Gen Phone Display Protection Explained
summary: Corning Gorilla Glass Victus is the latest iteration of strengthened glass technology designed for smartphones and other mobile devices, succeeding Gorilla Glass 6. It offers enhanced durability, demonstrating superior performance in drop and scratch resistance due to continuous improvements by Corning. The new glass can survive an average of twenty one-meter drops and offers twice the scratch resistance compared to Gorilla Glass 6, with minimal additional manufacturing cost.

title: CAI Achieves Milestone: White Paper Sets the Standard for Content Attribution
summary: The Content Authenticity Initiative (CAI) has released a white paper titled "Setting the Standard for Content Attribution," addressing the growing problem of inauthentic media. The paper proposes an industry-standard solution for content attribution, enabling creators to securely attach their identity and information to their work, thereby increasing transparency and combating misleading content. This system aims to provide cryptographic verification of media provenance from creation to consumption, ensuring trust and crediting creators.

title: Freshworks for Startups’ Against All Odds Startup Summit brings offline networking and experiential learning online
summary: Freshworks for Startups is hosting the "Against All Odds Startup Summit" to bridge the networking gap prevalent in virtual events. This summit, powered by AWS, focuses on 1:1 networking, roundtable discussions, and VC connections for over 1000 founders and 40 speakers. It also offers experiential learning from established startup founders and VCs, with a global scale across different regions to provide local market insights.

title: Microsoft Named a Visionary for its Power Automate solution in the 2020 Magic Quadrant for Robotic Process Automation - Microsoft Power Platform Blog
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Visionary in the 2020 Magic Quadrant for Robotic Process Automation by Gartner, specifically for its Power Automate solution. The company attributes this recognition to customer and community feedback, highlighting Power Automate's role as a holistic automation platform that integrates RPA with API-based automation and AI within a low-code environment. Microsoft also expanded its capabilities through the acquisition of Softomotive, aiming to offer a comprehensive, easily accessible automation service.

title: G&J Pepsi pours in-house expertise into perfect apps with low-code Power Apps driven by Power Automate
summary: G&J Pepsi-Cola Bottlers leveraged Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, to create in-house applications, significantly boosting efficiency and saving over $1.5 million. By empowering its IT team and integrating various Microsoft solutions, the company developed apps for tasks like store audits, budgeting, and employee onboarding, eliminating the need for expensive external development and subscription services. This strategy has allowed G&J Pepsi to innovate rapidly, optimize processes, and prepare for future technological advancements, including a Microsoft Dynamics 365 migration.

title: Microsoft Teams lower cost basic IP Phones and USB Phones coming early 2021
summary: Microsoft announced new cost-effective IP Phones for Microsoft Teams, which will be available from AudioCodes, Poly, and Yealink starting early 2021. Additionally, Microsoft will support new USB peripherals with dial pads and a Teams UI, connecting to PCs and Macs, with the first, Yealink MP50, shipping in late 2020. These new devices aim to provide affordable and convenient options for common areas and basic information worker scenarios within the Microsoft Teams ecosystem.

title: Social Glue and Post-COVID Labour Markets: Evidence from a Task Census of a Large Corporation
summary: This research analyzes job descriptions of a large corporation to identify tasks, dubbed "social glue," that facilitate essential information exchange across various roles and hierarchies. The study suggests that the rapid adoption of video-calling and collaboration tools post-COVID has laid the groundwork for new approaches to social cohesion, significantly impacting job design, organizational structure, and commuting patterns.

title: Microsoft commits to achieve ‘zero waste’ goals by 2030
summary: Microsoft announced its goal to achieve zero waste for its direct operations, products, and packaging by 2030. This initiative involves reducing waste, reusing and repurposing hardware through Microsoft Circular Centers, eliminating single-use plastics in packaging by 2025, and investing in waste data improvement and circular economy solutions. The company also aims to engage employees and empower customers with technology to reduce waste.

title: Introducing Cloudflare Network Interconnect
summary: Cloudflare announced Cloudflare Network Interconnect (CNI), allowing customers to directly link their branch and HQ locations with Cloudflare's network. This service offers enhanced security, reliability, and performance by bypassing the public internet for connectivity to Cloudflare's full suite of network functions. CNI supports various Cloudflare products like Access, CDN, Magic Transit, and Workers, providing a scalable and flexible solution for secure and optimized network integration globally.

title: Inside Hudson Pacific and Blackstone’s field of streams
summary: This article details Blackstone Group's acquisition of a 49 percent stake in Hudson Pacific Properties' $1.65 billion Hollywood real estate portfolio, focusing on soundstages and capitalizing on the streaming industry boom. It explores the strategic motivations for both companies, the financial implications, and the future prospects of their partnership, including potential further acquisitions in the competitive Los Angeles real estate market. The deal highlights the growing demand for soundstage space fueled by content creation for streaming services like Netflix.

title: Microsoft adds Virtual Desktop and Android TV support for its Remote Desktop app
summary: Microsoft has updated its Remote Desktop app for Android to version 10.0.7, introducing full support for Windows Virtual Desktop, Android TV devices, and integration with Microsoft Authenticator. The update also features a rewritten client using the same RDP core engine as the iOS and macOS versions, along with an improved Connection Center and in-session UI. Microsoft is also maintaining a legacy version for users who prefer the older app.

title: CPR Anti-Debug Encyclopedia: The Check Point Anti-Debug Techniques Repository
summary: Check Point Research (CPR) has compiled an "Anti-Debug Encyclopedia," a repository of anti-debugging techniques used by malware. This resource describes various anti-debug tricks, their implementation in C/C++ or x86/x86-64 Assembly, and mitigation strategies for developers. The encyclopedia aims to help analysts understand how these techniques work, assess debuggers, and improve anti-anti-debug plugins.

title: New life for old corporate computers so students can learn from home
summary: Microsoft, with corporate partners and computer refurbishers, is helping Hong Kong students in need by donating over 1,000 refurbished computers. This initiative addresses the challenges of remote learning, particularly for students who previously relied on smartphones for schoolwork. The program aims to improve students' learning experience, health, and academic performance, while also promoting blended learning beyond the pandemic.

title: Building patient trust and empowering healthcare with Microsoft Dynamics
summary: The article discusses how the healthcare industry is rapidly evolving due to digitization and changing patient demands, necessitating greater empathy and technological integration. It highlights the importance of a "Patient 360 view" and personalized solutions, especially given regional variations and compliance needs. Wipro has developed a complete care solution based on Microsoft D365 to enhance patient journeys, improve collaboration among stakeholders, and drive operational efficiency in healthcare.

title: Zscaler Internet Access Achieves FedRAMP “In Process” Status
summary: Zscaler's Internet Access (ZIA) has achieved Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) “In Process” status at the High Impact level, sponsored by a U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) Command. This milestone highlights Zscaler's commitment to supporting federal agencies in their IT modernization and cloud adoption efforts, ensuring secure access to cloud services and SaaS applications. Zscaler's other public sector achievements include Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) becoming FedRAMP High Baseline JAB Authorized and working toward DoD compliance at Impact Levels 4 and 5.

title: Logitech G Delivers Ultra Realistic Racing With TRUEFORCE Racing Wheel for PC and Xbox One
summary: Logitech G has unveiled the G923 Racing Wheel and Pedals, featuring a new high-definition force feedback system called TRUEFORCE, designed to revolutionize sim racing with ultra-realistic experiences. This technology processes game physics and audio in real-time, delivering enhanced feedback that allows players to feel track terrain, engine roars, and tire traction with unprecedented detail. The G923 also includes new features like programmable dual-clutch launch controls, a built-in rev indicator, on-wheel game controls, progressive brake pedals, and a 24-point selection dial, launching in August 2020 for $399.99.

title: TikTok, Trump and an Impulse to Act as C.E.O. to Corporate America (Published 2020)
summary: President Trump has consistently intervened in corporate affairs, a departure from previous administrations, a behavior exemplified by his recent handling of TikTok. After initially threatening to ban the Chinese-owned app due to national security concerns, he reversed course, stating it could continue operating if purchased by an American company like Microsoft. Trump also insisted a "very substantial portion" of the sale price should go to the U.S. Treasury, highlighting his "undisciplined and impulsive decision-making style."

title: Leading Hong Kong and Global Companies Selected SAP Procurement Solutions to Transition to New Normal
summary: SAP announced that numerous leading companies globally and in Hong Kong have adopted SAP Ariba and SAP Fieldglass solutions to streamline their procurement processes, manage costs, reduce risk, and maintain supply chain integrity amidst economic challenges. Companies like Techtronic Industries, Carlsberg Group, and Vestas Wind Systems implemented these solutions to enhance digital transformation, improve spend visibility, and ensure business continuity. The increasing adoption underscores the critical role of digital procurement in navigating supply chain disruptions and fostering efficiency.

title: Microsoft Vet Steve Walters Appointed ServiceNow Federal VP
summary: Steve Walters, a former general manager of Microsoft's federal civilian business, has been appointed as the Vice President of ServiceNow's federal group. Walters brings nine years of experience from Microsoft, where he managed U.S. Army and joint and defense accounts, and also served eight years as an Army captain. ServiceNow, based in Santa Clara, Calif., provides a unified platform for digital workflow applications, and Walters' hire is expected to bolster their federal operations.

title: Dow jumps 350 points to start week, S&P 500 inches closer to all-time high
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rallied over 350 points on Monday, driven by gains in economically sensitive stocks. The S&P 500 also rose, closing less than 1% away from its all-time high, while the Nasdaq Composite struggled as investors trimmed positions in mega-cap tech stocks. The market moves followed President Trump's executive orders for extending coronavirus relief benefits amidst ongoing stimulus package negotiations in Congress.

title: Gartner: IaaS Public Cloud Services Market Grew 37.3% In 2019
summary: The global infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) market for public cloud services saw a 37.3% growth in 2019, reaching $44.5 billion, with Amazon Web Services (AWS) maintaining its lead despite a slight market share decrease. Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud experienced significant growth, while Chinese providers Alibaba Cloud and Tencent also showed strong market expansion. Gartner plans to combine IaaS and PaaS into a new category called Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Services (CIPS) for future reporting to better reflect market realities.

title: DevSecOps Demystified: Securing the Dev and Ops Worlds
summary: This article demystifies DevSecOps, highlighting how the integration of security practices into the DevOps ecosystem can address common challenges faced by organizations. It discusses how siloed security and risk management processes can hinder agile development and proposes DevSecOps approaches to automate static and dynamic analysis, securely manage enterprise DevOps tools, and ensure security hardening during dynamic environment spin-ups. The authors emphasize that incorporating security, risk, and compliance directly into the development pipeline is no longer optional but a mandate for achieving speed without compromising security.

title: Banks and tech giants including JPMorgan and Amazon pledge to hire 100,000 minority and low-income New Yorkers
summary: A new organization called the New York Jobs CEO Council, comprising leaders from 27 firms including JPMorgan, IBM, and Amazon, has pledged to hire 100,000 people from low-income Black, Latino, and Asian communities by 2030. The initiative aims to address inequality exacerbated by the coronavirus pandemic, providing entry-level jobs and apprenticeships, with 25,000 specifically for CUNY students. Co-chairs include Jamie Dimon, Arvind Krishna, and Julie Sweet, with support from other tech and finance giants.

title: Equinix Enters India with a $161M Mumbai Data Center Acquisition
summary: Equinix is expanding into India, one of the world's fastest-growing digital services markets, through a $161 million acquisition of a two-data center campus in Mumbai from GPX Global Systems. The acquisition is strategic as the campus already hosts major cloud service providers, networks, and internet exchanges, giving Equinix a strong foothold in the country. This move aligns with increased investment in India's digital infrastructure by both specialist data center providers and international cloud giants.

title: Jack in the Box Goes All-In on AWS
summary: Jack in the Box is migrating its entire IT infrastructure to Amazon Web Services (AWS), moving away from on-premises data centers to enhance flexibility, resilience, and operational efficiency across its 2,200+ restaurants. This transition involves utilizing AWS's cloud services, including Amazon RDS and Redshift, for data management, enabling advanced analytics for sales and inventory, and leveraging machine learning for improved customer service and personalized marketing. The move aims to innovate digital experiences, optimize operations, and better adapt to changing business conditions.

title: PPP likely saved 35 million jobs, says JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon
summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon estimates that the government's Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) saved between 30 to 35 million jobs by providing loans to small businesses affected by the coronavirus pandemic. Dimon praised the swift action of lawmakers and the administration, but also highlighted the need to extend the program, especially for minority-owned businesses that may not have initially received adequate funds. He also discussed the formation of the New York Jobs CEO Council to address the racial wealth gap and economic inequality, anticipating a delayed economic recession and stressing the importance of safely reopening the economy.

title: Payments giant Stripe poaches General Motors' CFO in its latest high-profile hire
summary: Payments company Stripe has hired General Motors' Chief Financial Officer Dhivya Suryadevara as it expands its executive team amidst a boom in e-commerce. Suryadevara, who led GM through a challenging financial period, will focus on aggressive growth while maintaining fiscal responsibility at Stripe. This move is part of a series of high-profile hires by Stripe, which has seen significant growth, especially during the pandemic, and is currently valued at $36 billion.

title: Two beverage giants choose cloud partners
summary: PepsiCo and Keurig Dr Pepper have each signed long-term cloud technology contracts with Microsoft and Google Cloud, respectively, to modernize their digital networks. PepsiCo's partnership with Microsoft aims to improve service delivery, innovation, and sustainability, while Keurig Dr Pepper's agreement with Google Cloud supports its digital transformation by migrating major applications and retiring data centers. Both companies are leveraging cloud solutions for greater agility, data insights, and operational resilience.

title: Standard Chartered Bank partners with Microsoft to become a cloud-first bank
summary: Standard Chartered Bank has announced a three-year strategic partnership with Microsoft to accelerate its digital transformation through a cloud-first strategy, primarily using Microsoft Azure. This collaboration aims to enhance banking processes with AI and data analytics, delivering personalized client experiences and moving core systems to the cloud by 2025. The partnership also includes leveraging Microsoft 365 and Teams to improve productivity and collaboration for the bank's global workforce.

title: Investing in Nasdaq 100 in 2000
summary: This article analyzes the long-term performance of investing in the Nasdaq 100 in 2000, a period of extremely high valuations. The author conducts an in-depth study showing that while the index as a whole tripled in value by 2020, this was driven by a small number of winning companies, particularly Apple and Amazon, and required significant patience through a prolonged drawdown. summary: Tractor Supply Company announced its partnership with the American Connection Project Broadband Coalition, pledging up to $1 million to help close the digital divide in rural America. summary: Microsoft has warned that Russian military intelligence hackers, previously responsible for the Democratic National Committee attack, are targeting campaign staff, consultants, and think tanks associated with both Democrats and Republicans with new, stealthier methods. This acquisition is expected to significantly boost Microsoft's Xbox Game Pass subscriber base and strengthen its position in the video game market against rivals like Sony and Nintendo. The deal comes amidst a growing video games market, driven by cloud gaming, 5G deployment, AR/VR, and COVID-19 induced stay-at-home trends.

title: Analog Devices Collaborates with Microsoft to Mass Produce State-of-the-Art 3D Imaging Products and Solutions
summary: Analog Devices (ADI) has announced a strategic collaboration with Microsoft to mass produce advanced 3D imaging products and solutions, utilizing Microsoft’s 3D time-of-flight (ToF) sensor technology. This partnership aims to deliver high-performance 3D solutions with enhanced depth accuracy for various applications including Industry 4.0, automotive, gaming, and augmented reality. ADI will design, manufacture, and sell a new series of 3D ToF imagers and systems, with the first products expected to release by the end of 2020.

title: Introducing Azure Orbital: Process Satellite Data At Cloud-Scale + SES Signs On…
summary: Microsoft has launched Azure Orbital, a new ground station service that integrates satellite operations directly with Azure’s cloud platform, enabling satellite operators to control satellites, process data, and scale operations. This service aims to address global challenges by leveraging cloud capabilities for vast amounts of data from space. SES has partnered with Microsoft, selecting Azure Orbital to collocate ground stations for its next-generation O3b mPOWER communication system, streamlining operations and accelerating digital transformation.

title: Oracle is a distant laggard in cloud infrastructure market even after TikTok deal
summary: Despite recent high-profile customer wins like TikTok and Zoom, Oracle remains a "niche player" in the cloud infrastructure market, significantly trailing leaders Amazon, Microsoft, and Google. Gartner estimates Oracle's market share at around 2%, and analysts note that its growth is still heavily reliant on traditional database software, with its stock performance lagging behind major cloud competitors. The TikTok deal, while a "shot in the arm," is viewed by some analysts as politically motivated rather than a testament to Oracle's competitive cloud capabilities.

title: Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF
summary: This article provides a detailed profile of the Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF (QYLG), including its current price, performance metrics, expenses, and holdings. It also contrasts QYLG with other ETFs in similar categories based on factors like expense ratio, assets under management, and year-to-date returns. The report offers an in-depth analysis of the ETF's concentration, valuation, dividend, fund flows, and ESG scores, giving a comprehensive overview for potential investors.

title: Beijing unlikely to approve Oracle, Walmart's TikTok deal - Global Times
summary: A state-backed Chinese newspaper, Global Times, reported that Beijing is unlikely to approve the deal struck by Oracle Corp and Walmart Inc with ByteDance regarding TikTok. The newspaper characterized the deal as "unfair" and catering to "unreasonable demands" from Washington, potentially harming China's national security and dignity. China's government has largely refrained from direct comments, though the foreign ministry has advocated for a fair environment for foreign companies.

title: HubSpot CRM gets enterprise makeover
summary: HubSpot has introduced a revamped Sales Hub Enterprise CRM, aiming to scale with growing businesses and appeal to larger organizations, including prospective Salesforce customers. The new offering includes advanced reporting, CPQ, and integrations with systems like LinkedIn Navigator and various accounting platforms. Analyst Liz Miller notes that this move positions HubSpot to compete more directly in the enterprise market by filling functional gaps while leveraging its existing reputation as a user-friendly tool for small and midmarket businesses.

title: AT&T and Microsoft to streamline cloud connectivity for IoT devices worldwide
summary: AT&T and Microsoft are partnering to streamline cloud connectivity for Internet of Things (IoT) devices globally. They are launching an integrated IoT solution featuring an AT&T-powered guardian device with Azure Sphere, enabling businesses to securely connect machines to the cloud without relying on public internet or third-party Wi-Fi. This collaboration aims to simplify massive IoT deployments, improve security, and help various industries transform operations.

title: Securing Remote Work: Prisma Access and Prisma Cloud With Azure AD
summary: This article discusses the integration of Palo Alto Networks' Prisma Access and Prisma Cloud with Microsoft Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) to secure remote workforces. It highlights the challenges of traditional VPNs in hybrid environments and explains how the combined solution provides identity- and policy-driven secure access, conditional access, and continuous monitoring for users across diverse locations and cloud platforms. The integrations were slated for customer availability in October 2020.

title: ClassEDU Launches to Bring "Class for Zoom" Product to Market to Help Millions of Teachers and Students Learning Online Due To COVID
summary: ClassEDU Inc. announced its launch and secured $16 million in seed financing to bring its "Class for Zoom" product to market. This platform aims to enhance online learning by adding features like attendance tracking, assignment distribution, and quizzes to Zoom, making virtual classrooms feel more like in-person ones. The funding round saw participation from key Zoom investors and prominent education leaders, recognizing the critical need for improved remote learning solutions hastened by the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Investing in the Nasdaq-100: Why an Equal-Weight Version Presents a Tactical Choice
summary: This article discusses the benefits and considerations of investing in an equal-weighted Nasdaq-100 (NDXE) compared to the traditional market-cap-weighted Nasdaq-100 (NDX). It highlights how NDXE offers reduced concentration in mega-cap firms and the Technology sector, providing a tactical choice given historical turnover among market leaders. The article also compares NDXE's performance and volatility with NDX and the S&P 500 equal-weighted index (SPW).

title: Is the VGS ETF the best for passive investing?
summary: This article examines the Vanguard MSCI Index International Shares ETF (ASX: VGS) as a strong option for passive investing due to its broad diversification across over 1,500 businesses in major developed countries. It highlights VGS's sector allocation, top holdings including tech giants, and its average annual return of 9.65% over the past five years. The piece concludes that while VGS offers good diversification, investors should consider its management fee compared to other ETFs and explore various options for growth and dividends.

title: Future of Sales 2025: Why B2B Sales Needs a Digital-First Approach
summary: The article discusses the accelerated shift towards digital-first B2B sales, predicting that by 2025, 80% of sales interactions will occur in digital channels. It emphasizes the need for sales leaders to adopt a digital mindset, diversify digital selling tools, and rethink sales enablement to cater to evolving customer buying preferences. The transformation necessitates adaptive systems to optimize digital interactions and maintain relevance.

title: Vitality: Delivering a valuable experience for customers
summary: Vitality, founded in 2004, distinguishes itself in the insurance market by integrating wellness into its offerings, aiming to improve customers' lives and encouraging 100 million people to be 20% more active by 2025. Chief Digital Officer Dave Priestley explains how the company uses digital transformation, including an innovative member app, to deliver value and a superior customer experience. Despite initial challenges with legacy systems, Vitality has leveraged technology and partnerships, such as with TCS, to create a unified customer platform and adapt rapidly to new demands like the COVID-19 pandemic, all while focusing on customer-centric outcomes.

title: Spotify, Match Launch Coalition to Protest App Store Rules
summary: Spotify, Match Group, Epic Games, and 10 other organizations have formed the Coalition for App Fairness to challenge the app store rules of Apple and Google. The coalition introduced "App Store Principles," advocating against platform owners using developer data to compete and requiring exclusive use of their app stores or payment systems. This move aims to pressure Apple and Google into modifying their existing app store guidelines.

title: 3 quick reasons I like the IOO ETF
summary: The iShares Global 100 ETF (ASX: IOO) is recommended for its three key features: diversification from the Australian market, exposure to global developed and emerging markets, and investment in strong, growing businesses with entrenched economic moats. The article highlights its holdings in major global companies like Apple and Microsoft, and its 10-year average annual return of 13.1%. The author suggests it's a good option for investors seeking to diversify beyond ASX shares.

title: Texas Software Provider to Local Governments Reports Data Breach
summary: Tyler Technologies, a software provider for local governments and schools, announced a data breach affecting its internal network and phone systems. While the company stated that client data and hosted systems were not believed to be impacted, a cybersecurity expert warned of potential risks to customer passwords and suggested immediate password resets as a precaution. The incident is being investigated, and the FBI has been contacted.

title: Microsoft Teams telephony Survivable Branch Appliances (SBA)
summary: Microsoft announced that partners will offer Survivable Branch Appliances (SBAs) for Microsoft Teams telephony. These SBAs will enable telephony to function via a PSTN connection even when internet or Office 365 connectivity is lost, utilizing a new "Teams Offline mode." Ribbon and AudioCodes are among the first vendors to provide SBA support for Teams.

title: EM’s Weekly Roundup: Accenture Invests $3B to Establish Cloud Division; Veritas/DXC Health Deal to Close Oct. 1st; SAIC Reorganizing Business Structure; LTG Bruce Crawford Joins Rubrik Advisory Board; Collins Aerospace Receives $317M Contract
summary: This weekly roundup covers significant events in the government contracting and technology sectors. Key highlights include Accenture's $3 billion investment to form a new cloud division, Veritas Capital's impending $5 billion acquisition of DXC Technology's health business, and SAIC's reorganization to accelerate growth. Additionally, LTG Bruce Crawford joined Rubrik's advisory board, and Collins Aerospace secured a $317 million contract for radio communication systems.

title: Detecting VBA Process Hollowing With Cortex XDR
summary: Palo Alto Networks' Unit 42 has observed advanced VBA activity, specifically VBA-RunPE, which is an implementation of the RunPE technique allowing executables to run from memory in Microsoft Word and Excel to evade detection. Attackers use this process hollowing technique to hide malicious code inside legitimate processes and bypass application whitelisting. Cortex XDR, with its behavioral detectors and the latest Agent 7.2, provides protection against VBA-RunPE by identifying anomalous behavior like suspicious command-line arguments and unusual DLL loads by Office processes.

title: Yom Kippur marks the Jewish holiday of free speech
summary: This article discusses the concept of free speech within the context of the Jewish holiday of Yom Kippur, drawing parallels to contemporary debates surrounding social media platforms and Section 230 of the U.S. Communications Decency Act. The author argues that while free speech is invaluable, it must have critical limits, especially concerning harmful content like fake news and hate speech. The piece suggests that regulations are needed to restrain offensive speech in a way that ultimately promotes genuine free speech rather than undermining it.

title: AiThority Interview with Chris Kozup, CMO at Aruba Networks (a Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company)
summary: Chris Kozup, CMO at Aruba, discusses his role, the challenges facing a CMO in the networking industry, and how Aruba is adapting its marketing strategies. He highlights the shift towards data at the Edge and the importance of digital engagement, especially in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic. Kozup also shares insights on content formats, measuring marketing success, and the future of marketing in a post-COVID era, emphasizing a "Customer First, Customer Last" mindset.

title: HP Reverb G2: premium experience with cutting-edge technology by Jose Antunes - ProVideo Coalition
summary: The HP Reverb G2 VR headset is presented as the new standard for PC Virtual Reality, offering a premium and immersive experience with cutting-edge technology at an affordable price. It boasts the world's highest resolution among major vendors and has received updates to improve clarity and ease of use. The article positions it as a superior alternative to the discontinued Oculus Rift S and the untethered Oculus Quest 2, especially for users seeking a high-quality PCVR experience.

title: Humana And Salesforce Partner Up To Deliver More Personalized Care
summary: Humana and Salesforce have announced a multi-year partnership to enhance personalized care for Humana's 13 million customers. Utilizing Salesforce Health Cloud's new Enterprise Clinical Operating Model (ECOM), Humana aims to improve communication between patients, providers, and claims experts by integrating electronic health records. This collaboration seeks to digitize healthcare processes, especially in light of the COVID-19 pandemic's impact on virtual care.

title: Lenovo Expands Stylish ThinkBook Portfolio to Enhance New Working Models
summary: Lenovo has significantly expanded its ThinkBook portfolio, introducing six new models designed for modern professionals and the "work-from-anywhere" environment. The new lineup includes laptops like the ThinkBook 15 Gen 2 i with integrated wireless earbuds and the ThinkBook 14s Yoga i, a 2-in-1 model, alongside a new ThinkVision T27hv-20 USB-C Hub monitor. These devices emphasize enhanced collaboration, security features like Smart Guard, and intuitive software, catering to the evolving needs of small and medium businesses.

title: AI improves customer experience, call center efficiency
summary: This article discusses how Artificial Intelligence (AI) can enhance customer experience and call center efficiency, especially given the increased interaction volume due to COVID-19. It highlights how AI can automate routine tasks, provide self-service options, and make agents more productive by offering personalized experiences and predictive analytics. The piece also details various forms of AI being adopted, such as predictive routing, sentiment analysis, and voice transcription, along with case studies demonstrating successful implementations and their benefits.

title: Worlds Inc. vs. Microsoft in Patent Infringement Lawsuit Related to “Minecraft”
summary: Worlds Inc. has filed a patent infringement complaint against Microsoft Corporation, alleging that its "Minecraft" video game product infringes on Worlds' U.S. Patent No. 8,082,501. This patent, related to 3D online virtual worlds, previously survived validity challenges against Activision Blizzard and Bungie Inc. Worlds Inc. seeks to enforce its intellectual property rights and secure compensation for its foundational technology.

title: EA Play games join Xbox Game Pass Ultimate in November
summary: EA Play's game library will officially be added to Xbox Game Pass Ultimate on November 10, coinciding with the launch of the Xbox Series X and S. This integration brings 89 EA-published titles, 10 hours of free gameplay for select new EA releases, and a 10% discount on digital EA content to Ultimate subscribers. EA Play games will also become available for PC users in December and for Android mobile devices via xCloud.

title: Fiat Chrysler CEO MIke Manley will not be on Stellantis board after merger with Groupe PSA
summary: Fiat Chrysler CEO Mike Manley will not be joining the Stellantis board after the merger with Groupe PSA, despite the 50-50 stock split, as PSA will name six board members compared to FCA's five. Manley is expected to continue with Stellantis in a senior executive role, which has not yet been specified. The combined company, set to become the world's fourth-largest automaker, has announced 11 board members, including chairman John Elkann and CEO Carlos Tavares.

title: NatWest offers online banking customers free security services
summary: NatWest Group is partnering with Malwarebytes to offer its online banking customers free access to advanced endpoint protection services. This initiative comes in response to a significant increase in online banking fraud, especially during the Covid-19 pandemic, affecting both personal and business users. The service, available across all NatWest Group brands, allows customers to install Malwarebytes Premium on multiple devices to enhance their cyber security.

title: Campbell CIO: ERP modernization key to absorbing $5B acquisition
summary: Campbell Soup Company modernized its ERP system by migrating from Oracle to SAP HANA 2.0 to absorb the increased transactional volume from its nearly $5 billion acquisition of Snyder's-Lance. This incremental upgrade was crucial for real-time analytics, business continuity, and agility, especially during the pandemic-driven changes in consumer demand. The company plans a future transition to SAP S/4 HANA for advanced analytics.

title: Good story, bad investment
summary: Thematic ETFs often present compelling narratives around long-term trends like AI or electric vehicles, but Morningstar analyst Alex Bryan warns that a good story doesn't guarantee a sound investment. Investors must successfully bet on three factors: the macro trend playing out, the portfolio companies significantly benefiting, and the market not having already priced in the growth. Historically, most thematic ETFs underperform and many fail to survive long-term, making caution and thorough due diligence essential.

title: Microsoft named a leader in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in Gartner's 2020 Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service (EiPaaS) Magic Quadrant for the third consecutive year, based on its ability to execute and completeness of vision. The company's Azure Integration Services (AIS), including API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and Event Grid, offers extensive integration capabilities with over 370 connectors. AIS is used by over 40,000 customers globally, including more than 60 percent of Fortune 500 companies.

title: Delivering 3D Creators' Visions to Customers the Way They Intended
summary: Sony has developed the Eye-sensing Light Field Display (ELFD) to overcome the limitations of conventional 3D displays by offering a glasses-free, high-definition 3D experience with real-time eye-tracking and rendering. This technology aims to accurately reproduce creators' 3D visions and is being explored for applications in product design, entertainment, and various B2B fields, with ongoing efforts to expand its capabilities for larger systems and multiple viewers.

title: IonQ Unveils World's Most Powerful Quantum Computer
summary: IonQ has revealed its next-generation quantum computer, featuring 32 "perfect qubits" and an expected quantum volume exceeding 4,000,000. This new system, which boasts improved fidelity and is built on decades of research, will be available through Amazon Braket and Microsoft's Azure Quantum. IonQ aims to significantly increase its qubit count annually, with two more generations of hardware already in development.

title: Introducing the World’s Most Powerful Quantum Computer
summary: IonQ has unveiled its new quantum computer, which is described as the most powerful on the market, featuring 32 perfect qubits and a quantum volume of at least 4,000,000. This development validates IonQ's trapped-ion approach and positions quantum computing as the next major technological revolution, with the potential to transform numerous industries and create trillions in economic value. The system will initially be available to partners via private beta, then commercially on AWS Braket and Microsoft Azure Quantum in early 2021, aiming to accelerate the adoption and development of quantum applications.

title: The Most Popular ESG ETF is also a Five-Star Fund
summary: The iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF (ESGU), a five-star rated fund by CFRA, is highlighted for its strong record and appealing holdings. Despite excluding some companies based on ESG criteria, ESGU has outperformed the S&P 500 Index over various periods and maintains a sector exposure similar to the broader market. CFRA recommends ESGU for investors seeking ESG-focused strategies, citing its low expense ratio and growing popularity.

title: Videogame Stocks Have Soared for 20 Years. They’re About to Get Another Boost.
summary: The article discusses the upcoming launch of new videogame consoles, Microsoft's Xbox Series X and Sony's PlayStation 5, which are expected to boost videogame stocks. Despite pandemic-related delays in other industries, these major consumer events are proceeding on schedule. The piece highlights the past strong performance of videogame stocks and anticipates further growth with the new console generation.

title: IonQ Unveils New 32-Qubit Quantum Computer
summary: IonQ has unveiled a new 32-qubit quantum computer with low gate errors, expecting a quantum volume greater than 4,000,000. This new system features perfect atomic clock qubits and random access all-to-all gate operations, and will be available via private beta before commercial release on Amazon Braket and Microsoft's Azure Quantum. IonQ plans to continue rapidly increasing qubit count and improving fidelity, with two new generations of hardware already in development.

title: Birthday week: Cloudflare turns 10
summary: Cloudflare celebrated its 10th birthday with a "Birthday Week" featuring several significant announcements. Key updates included advancements in their Workers platform with Durable Objects and Cron Triggers, a new privacy-focused Web Analytics product, and the launch of Cloudflare Radar for real-time internet traffic insights. The company also introduced API enhancements like gRPC support and API Shield, and Automatic Platform Optimization for improved website performance, starting with WordPress.

title: Larry Ellison's TikTok bid puts Oracle chairman back in the spotlight
summary: Oracle Corp. co-founder Larry Ellison's pursuit of a deal with TikTok could significantly boost Oracle's cloud-computing business and put him back in the tech industry spotlight. The proposed deal involves Oracle and Walmart Inc. taking a combined 20% stake in a new U.S.-based TikTok, with Oracle guaranteeing the security of U.S. user data. This move is seen as a way for Oracle to gain traction against market leaders like Amazon and Microsoft in the cloud computing sector, an area Ellison once dismissed.

title: A.I. gets down in the dirt as precision agriculture takes off
summary: Artificial intelligence is becoming a crucial tool in agriculture, helping farmers to significantly boost yields, minimize waste, and reduce pollution. Companies like Deere & Co. are integrating A.I. into their machinery for real-time adjustments during harvest, while startups like Ceres Imaging offer data-driven insights through aerial imaging to optimize resource use. This shift towards precision agriculture promises substantial cost savings and increased farmer incomes by improving efficiency and reducing environmental impact.

title: NVIDIA Introduces New Family of BlueField DPUs to Bring Breakthrough Networking, Storage and Security Performance to Every Data Center
summary: NVIDIA has announced a new family of Data Processing Units (DPUs) called BlueField, accompanied by the DOCA software development kit, to enhance networking, storage, and security performance in data centers. These DPUs offload critical tasks from CPUs, thereby freeing up processing power for other enterprise applications. Major server manufacturers and software partners like VMware, Red Hat, and Canonical are integrating NVIDIA DPUs into their offerings.

title: Microsoft announces plans for first datacenter region in Greece as part of “GR for GRowth” digital transformation initiative
summary: Microsoft has announced its "GR for GRowth" initiative, which includes plans to build its first datacenter region in Greece and skill 100,000 people in digital technologies by 2025. This significant investment aims to accelerate the digitization of Greece's public sector and businesses, providing access to local cloud services and fostering economic growth. The initiative reflects Microsoft's confidence in Greece's future and its commitment to being a technology ally for the country's development.

title: Why does Microsoft have an office at the UN? A Q&A with the company’s UN lead – On the Issues
summary: Microsoft established a United Nations Affairs office in New York City to deepen its engagement with the UN on global issues like human rights, environmental sustainability, and digital empowerment. John Frank, Vice President of UN Affairs, explains that this initiative aims to foster multi-stakeholder collaborations to tackle pressing global challenges. The office focuses on building relationships, making Microsoft's partnerships more impactful, and helping the UN leverage technology for its missions.

title: Microsoft Corp. adds two West Des Moines data centers, five in all
summary: Microsoft is expanding its data center operations in West Des Moines by adding two new facilities, bringing its total to five in the city. The projects, each estimated to cost between $1-2 billion and employ 50-75 workers, are expected to break ground next September and open their first buildings in late 2022. The decision to expand is driven by growing demand for cloud computing and strategic considerations like skilled labor, fiber optic access, and reliable power.

title: Rockwell Automation and Microsoft Expand Partnership to Simplify Industrial Transformation
summary: Rockwell Automation and Microsoft have expanded their partnership with a five-year agreement to develop integrated, market-ready solutions for industrial customers. This collaboration aims to enhance digital agility through cloud technology, combining their expertise to help manufacturers save on infrastructure costs, speed time-to-value, and increase productivity. The partnership focuses on delivering innovative edge-to-cloud solutions that connect information seamlessly between development, operations, and maintenance teams, thereby removing data silos and accelerating industrial digital transformation.

title: HireVue acquires recruiting chatbot startup AllyO
summary: HireVue, a video interviewing vendor, has acquired AllyO, a startup specializing in chatbot technology for high-volume hiring. AllyO's conversational chatbots automate parts of the recruiting process, such as providing job information and conducting initial interviews. This acquisition aims to integrate AllyO's technology with HireVue's platform to enhance talent engagement and streamline the hiring process for companies.

title: Arm CEO Simon Segars discusses AI, data centers, getting acquired by Nvidia and more
summary: Arm CEO Simon Segars discusses the 2020 acquisition by Nvidia for $40 billion, highlighting the strategic alignment of both companies in AI and data centers. He emphasizes that the merger will accelerate Arm's trajectory into new markets like automotive and data centers, while also expanding their IP offerings. Segars addresses regulatory hurdles and concerns about licensing to Chinese companies, asserting that the deal is pro-competitive and will not alter Arm's licensing approach.

title: Rockwell Automation and Microsoft expand partnership to simplify industrial transformation
summary: Rockwell Automation and Microsoft have announced a five-year expanded partnership to simplify industrial transformation. The collaboration focuses on developing integrated, market-ready solutions leveraging cloud technology to improve digital agility for industrial customers. This partnership aims to connect development, operations, and maintenance teams through a singular, trusted data environment, enabling digital prototyping, secure data sharing, and accelerated innovation.

title: SAP® SuccessFactors® Employee Central Tops 4,000 Customers
summary: SAP announced its SuccessFactors® Employee Central solution has surpassed 4,000 customers, indicating its rapid growth as a core HR solution. The cloud-based Human Experience Management (HXM) suite offers global scalability, supporting 42 languages and over 2,000 regulatory changes annually for 99 countries. Customers praise the platform for streamlining HR processes, improving employee engagement, and enabling data-driven decisions.

title: IonQ Releases A New 32-Qubit Trapped-Ion Quantum Computer With Massive Quantum Volume Claims
summary: IonQ has released its 5th generation 32-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer, claiming an astounding quantum volume of 4 million, significantly higher than previously published records. While the company calculated this figure rather than running quantum volume circuits, they anticipate a research paper confirming the performance. This development marks a significant advancement in quantum computing, with plans for private betas and cloud platform deployment in 2021.

title: 2020 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Low-Code Application Platforms: Key Takeaways
summary: This article provides key takeaways from Gartner's 2020 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Low-Code Application Platforms, highlighting the growing importance of LCAPs due to application delivery challenges and developer shortages. It details Gartner's definition of LCAPs, projected adoption rates, typical use cases, and evaluates 18 providers across the niche players, challengers, visionaries, and leaders quadrants, noting specific strengths and new additions.

title: Damco Solutions added monday.com to its partnership pool to prioritize workplace transformation
