summary: Damco Solutions Inc. has announced a partnership with monday.com, a SaaS-based collaboration and productivity platform, to help businesses create future-ready digital workplaces. This strategic alliance aims to simplify project management and supercharge workforces with custom workflows, easy collaboration, automation, real-time reporting, and integrations. The partnership leverages Damco's IT services expertise and monday.com's platform to drive transformational experiences for global teams, especially expanding monday.com's presence in North America.

title: Private equity giant Blackstone set to open tech office in Miami
summary: Private equity firm Blackstone plans to open a technology-focused headquarters in Miami, creating up to 215 tech jobs with an average salary of $200,000. Miami-Dade County will provide up to $650,000 in job incentives, anticipating $910,303 in new tax revenue. This move signifies Miami's growing appeal as a tech hub, attracting other companies like Google, Microsoft, and Softbank.

title: IBM to break up 109-year old firm to focus on high-margin cloud computing
summary: IBM is splitting into two public companies, spinning off its IT infrastructure services unit to focus on high-margin cloud computing. This strategic move, spearheaded by CEO Arvind Krishna, aims to streamline the 109-year-old firm, allowing the remaining entity to concentrate on its software and solutions portfolio. The company expects to incur $2.5 billion in expenses related to the spin-off and projects Q3 revenue of $17.6 billion and an adjusted profit per share of $2.58.

title: GameStop announces multiyear strategic partnership with Microsoft
summary: GameStop Corp. announced a multi-year strategic partnership with Microsoft Corp. to advance its physical and digital video game offerings and enhance its retail technology infrastructure. The partnership will see GameStop standardize its business operations on Microsoft's cloud solutions and hardware, including Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Surface devices, to create a premier omni-channel gaming destination. It also expands GameStop's Xbox product offerings to include Xbox All Access, benefiting both companies in customer acquisition and lifetime revenue.

title: QQQ’s Stellar ETF Rise
summary: The article discusses the enduring success of the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) ETF despite criticisms of its underlying Nasdaq-100 index structure. It highlights QQQ's significant asset growth, strong performance against major indices, and its appeal to investors seeking exposure to tech and growth stocks, particularly among younger generations. The piece also delves into the unique rules and rebalancing methodology of the Nasdaq-100 and QQQ's substantial marketing efforts.

title: Videogames are about to get more expensive for the first time in 15 years
summary: Videogame prices are set to increase for the first time in 15 years, with new top-tier games for next-generation consoles priced at $70. This change coincides with the release of new Xbox and PlayStation consoles, affecting titles from publishers like Take-Two Interactive Software Inc., Microsoft Corp., and Sony Corp.

title: Foreign cloud service providers led by Amazon, MS play big in Korea
summary: Foreign cloud service providers, spearheaded by Amazon Web Services and Microsoft, are increasingly dominating South Korea's cloud computing market, capturing over half of it in 2019. Their aggressive expansion and investment in data centers in Korea are leading to higher growth rates compared to domestic providers. This trend is pushing local companies like Naver and Kakao to step up their own cloud infrastructure development and services.

title: 8x8 Sets Out a BYOC Course
summary: The article discusses 8x8's strategy to focus on providing bring-your-own-carrier (BYOC) voice connectivity, particularly for Microsoft Teams, which has renewed the importance of SIP trunking. 8x8 aims to support customers in leveraging their preferred communication tools by acting as a voice connectivity provider, recognizing that it cannot directly compete with Microsoft for all UCaaS customers. The company highlights its global infrastructure and value-added services like contact center functionalities as competitive advantages in this role.

title: JFrog up 68% since IPO, Oppenheimer sees 21% upside
summary: Oppenheimer initiated coverage on JFrog (Nasdaq: FROG) with an "Outperform" rating and a $90 price target, representing a 21.6% upside from its current price. Since its IPO, JFrog's share price has surged by 68%. The analyst believes JFrog will benefit from the accelerated shift to digital operations and growth in IT expenditure within the rapidly expanding DevOps market.

title: Illumina pledges US $20 million in sequencing tech for Africa
summary: Illumina has pledged $20 million in next-generation sequencing (NGS) technology, reagents, and training support over four years to the Africa Pathogen Genomics Initiative. This initiative, in partnership with the Africa CDC, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, and others, aims to strengthen pathogen genomics capacity in over 20 African countries. The goal is to enhance real-time surveillance of diseases like COVID-19, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria, and combat antimicrobial resistance by providing essential genomic information and infrastructure.

title: Advanced protection for web applications in Azure with Radware’s Microsoft Security integration
summary: This article discusses the challenges companies face in application security, including OWASP vulnerabilities, advanced BOT threats, and DDoS attacks. It highlights how Radware is collaborating with Microsoft Azure to offer advanced application protection, integrating Radware Security for Azure with Azure DDoS Protection and Microsoft Azure Sentinel. The solution provides a managed service for network and application security, designed for easy deployment across Azure regions, ensuring comprehensive protection against various attack types.

title: Bandwidth to Acquire International Cloud Communications Leader Voxbone
summary: Bandwidth (NASDAQ: BAND) announced its acquisition of Voxbone, an international cloud communications leader, for an enterprise value of €446 million EUR. This strategic move aims to supercharge global cloud communications by combining Bandwidth's U.S. presence with Voxbone's international platform covering over 60 countries, representing 93% of global GDP. The acquisition is expected to accelerate Bandwidth's international strategy and enhance its position in the $17.7 billion CPaaS market.

title: ‘Mysterious’ billionaire cashes in $127M worth of Gates-backed pharma stock
summary: David Shaw, a "mysterious" billionaire, has sold over $127 million worth of Schrödinger, Inc. (SDGR) stock, a company backed by Bill Gates. Schrödinger, Inc. has seen its stock rise significantly since its IPO, attracting attention due to the substantial holdings of both Shaw and Gates, who together own around 40% of the company. This article details Shaw's recent stock sales and highlights the significant influence both billionaires have on the high-tech drug discovery firm.

title: Bandwidth to Acquire Voxbone, Propel Global Expansion
summary: Bandwidth announced its plan to acquire Voxbone for approximately $527 million, with the aim of expanding its global reach and creating a single cloud communications platform spanning over 60 countries. This acquisition is expected to accelerate Bandwidth's international expansion, leveraging Voxbone's strong presence in Europe and Asia, and enable extensive cross-selling opportunities and a simplified "one-stop shop" for cloud communication services. The deal reflects the increasing momentum in cloud communications, expedited by the pandemic, making time more valuable than money for market expansion.

title: Peloton rolling out "Skip Intro" feature
summary: Peloton is introducing a "Skip Intro" feature for experienced riders, allowing them to bypass the minute-long class introductions. This feature will be available on Peloton hardware and the web, but not on their apps, and requires users to have completed at least five cycling classes to unlock it. The update aims to improve the workout experience for those already familiar with Peloton's interface and class structure.

title: Invesco NASDAQ Next Gen 100 ETF
summary: The Invesco NASDAQ Next Gen 100 ETF (QQQJ) tracks the NASDAQ Next Generation 100 Index, focusing on the largest non-financial stocks on Nasdaq that are not part of the Nasdaq-100 index. This ETF provides exposure to "junior" Nasdaq stocks, offering diversification from the large-cap tilt of the main QQQ and potentially identifying future growth companies. QQQJ was launched in 2020 and presents a lower expense ratio and different holdings compared to its larger counterparts.

title: Kristine Beitland
summary: This page profiles Kristine Beitland, Corporate Affairs Director at Microsoft Norway and a member of the Global Initiative Network. Her background includes extensive experience in law enforcement and security, having served 16 years in the police and held positions such as head of the Organized Crime Section at the National Police Directorate. She brings expertise in cyber-dependent crimes and her regional focus is Europe, specifically Norway.
source: Global Initiative against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC)
source_domain: Global Initiative against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC)

title: Verizon, T-Mobile, AT&T, others form North American 6G alliance
summary: Major North American wireless companies, including AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile, have formed the "Next G Alliance" to focus on the full lifecycle of 6G technology. This initiative, spurred by ATIS, aims to drive research, development, manufacturing, standardization, and market readiness for 6G, with commercial deployment expected in the next 8-10 years. The alliance also signifies growing nationalism in wireless technological development, specifically in response to advancements in China.

title: Apple Announces First 5G Smartphone, iPhone 12
summary: Apple has announced its first lineup of 5G-enabled smartphones, the iPhone 12 series, which includes four models: the iPhone 12, iPhone 12 Mini, iPhone 12 Pro, and iPhone 12 Pro Max. While these new phones support 5G technology for faster wireless speeds, the full benefits may not be immediately available to all users as 5G networks are still under construction in many regions. Aside from the phones, Apple also revealed a smaller, more affordable HomePod Mini smart speaker.
source: VOA - Voice of America English News
source_domain: VOA - Voice of America English News

title: BBVA launches Aqua, the first card without numbers or a CVV
summary: BBVA has launched Aqua, a new line of credit cards in Spain that enhances security by featuring a dynamic CVV code and omitting printed card numbers or expiration dates. This innovation aims to prevent fraudulent use both online and physically. The associated BBVA app also provides renewed payment management, allowing customers to easily access card details and control expenses, with plans for a global rollout of this experience.

title: Huya-Douyu merger creates a livestreaming behemoth under the control of Tencent
summary: Huya and Douyu, China's top gaming livestreaming platforms, are merging in a stock-for-stock deal, creating a dominant entity under Tencent's control. The merger aims to consolidate the market, reduce competition for broadcasters and broadcasting rights, and help Tencent fend off rising challenges from ByteDance's short video apps in the gaming sector. The combined company will boast over 80% market share in China's livestreaming industry, with Tencent holding a 67.5% voting power.

title: What Is Azure Site Recovery and How Do You Use It?
summary: Azure Site Recovery (ASR) is a leading Disaster Recovery as a Service (DRaaS) solution offered by Microsoft, providing fault tolerance and business continuity for various environments. It enables data replication to Azure with features like cost-effectiveness, data resilience, heterogeneous workload support, and non-disruptive testing. The article details the process of planning, preparing, configuring, executing failover/failback, and monitoring ASR, and also highlights how NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP can further enhance disaster recovery plans.

title: Threat Brief: Microsoft Vulnerability CVE-2020-16898
summary: This threat brief details CVE-2020-16898, a critical vulnerability in Microsoft's IPv6 Router Advertisement Options discovered during Patch Tuesday in October 2020. The vulnerability, residing in the Windows TCP/IP stack, can lead to Denial of Service and potentially remote code execution. The article provides mitigation steps, including disabling IPv6 RDNSS, and highlights protection offered by Palo Alto Networks' security subscriptions.

title: Bezos said warming is ‘biggest threat.’ Then he helped GOP
summary: Jeff Bezos, CEO of Amazon, publicly stated that climate change is the biggest threat to the planet, yet his personal political contributions and Amazon's PAC donations largely went to Republican senators who have opposed climate legislation. This pattern of donations to climate-skeptic lawmakers has drawn criticism and raises questions about the consistency of Amazon's stated climate commitments with its political spending. The article highlights a broader issue of corporations making climate pledges while financially supporting politicians who undermine those goals.

title: Augmented Reality (AR) Market Will Showcase Positive
summary: Technavio predicts that the Augmented Reality (AR) market is poised to grow by USD 76.99 billion during 2020-2024, driven significantly by the adoption of AR-enabled smart glasses. The market is concentrated with major players like Alphabet Inc. and Facebook Inc., and is expected to decelerate in concentration over the forecast period. The report highlights the increasing popularity of AR in smartphones and tablets as a key growth driver, offering detailed market analysis and segmentation.

title: Equinor collaborates with Microsoft on Northern Lights carbon capture and storage value chain
summary: Equinor has partnered with Microsoft to advance the Northern Lights carbon capture and storage (CCS) project. Microsoft will explore integrating its digital expertise into the project and potentially use the facility to store its captured CO2, aligning with its carbon-negative goals. This collaboration aims to accelerate the development of CCS technology and its contribution to meeting climate targets.

title: FDA Selects ICF for $49 Million IT Modernization BPA
summary: The FDA has selected global consulting and digital services provider ICF for a new single-award blanket purchase agreement (BPA) with a ceiling of $49 million over five years for IT modernization services. ICF will provide IT platform, operations and maintenance, advisory, and development services for the FDA's Digital Services Center, facilitating the adoption of cloud-based software and platform best practices across the agency. This partnership builds on ICF's 35 years of support for FDA clients, leveraging its expertise in multiplatform architecture, design services, strategic communications, analytics, and human-centered design.

title: Using Factors As a Magnifying Glass for Equities | MSCI
summary: This article explains how factors, such as value and momentum, can be used as a "magnifying glass" to understand the characteristics and drivers of individual stocks and equity portfolios, even within seemingly similar peer groups. Using MSCI FaCS, the analysis reveals significant differences in factor exposures for high-profile tech companies, airlines, and even mutual funds categorized as "growth" funds. The article highlights the utility of factors for institutional investors in due diligence, portfolio analysis, and communicating investment objectives.

title: Northern Lights is innovating for the future of carbon transport and storage
summary: The article details the Northern Lights project, a partnership between the Norwegian government, Equinor, Shell, and Total, focused on scaling carbon capture and storage (CCS) across Europe. Microsoft has joined the project as a technology partner to integrate its digital expertise and explore the use of the Northern Lights facility as part of its own carbon capture projects. The initiative aims to create a permanent storage solution for CO2 in the North Sea and develop a new business ecosystem around carbon management to achieve a net-zero carbon future.

title: The End of Anonymity? Ensuring Facial Recognition Is Used for Good
summary: Facial recognition technology is rapidly becoming commonplace, raising significant questions about privacy, ethical use, and regulation, especially in Canada. While it offers commercial benefits like personalized services and easier verification, its widespread application requires clear guidelines to prevent misuse and address concerns about surveillance and inherent biases in the technology. Canadian businesses are urged to approach this technology cautiously, educate themselves on risks, and advocate for federal regulatory guidance to ensure responsible adoption.

title: Zoom opens marketplace to apps that run within its platform
summary: Zoom is expanding its platform by opening a new marketplace for "Zapps," which are third-party applications deeply integrated into its video conferencing service. This initiative allows users to access collaboration, productivity, and education tools directly within Zoom, enhancing functionality and offering a best-of-breed approach. Additionally, Zoom introduced OnZoom, an event-hosting software, and announced SDK enhancements and broader hardware support.

title: Communities Thrive When They Are Safe: Motorola Solutions Brings Fully Integrated Software Suite to the Cloud to Streamline Operations for Public Safety Agencies and Expedite Response Times to Citizens
summary: Motorola Solutions announced the availability of its PremierOne® Cloud suite, powered by the CommandCentral software platform, for the U.S. public safety market. Hosted in Microsoft Azure Government, this integrated cloud-based offering aims to streamline operations for computer-aided dispatch (CAD), field response and reporting, and records management functions, ultimately expediting response times and enhancing situational awareness. The suite provides key benefits like faster deployment, increased security, and seamless scalability to help public safety agencies better serve their communities.

title: Tractor Supply gets technical
summary: Tractor Supply Company significantly advanced its digital and technical capabilities in 2020, launching its first mobile app, a new website, and expanding curbside pickup and delivery options. These technological advancements, combined with its status as an essential business during the COVID-19 pandemic, contributed to record sales, including a 35% jump in Q2 sales to $3.18 billion. The company also formed a strategic partnership with Microsoft to support its "ONETractor" strategy and modernize its e-commerce platform.

title: IYW ETF A Novel Look for Large Tech
summary: This article highlights the importance of large-cap tech exposure for financial advisors, especially given the sector's continued dominance during the COVID-19 pandemic. It discusses the Invesco QQQ ETF (QQQ) as a popular option and introduces the iShares U.S. Technology ETF (IYW) as an alternative for investors seeking exposure to top tech companies like Apple and Microsoft, emphasizing technology's vital role regardless of political changes.

title: Windows XP source code is leaked across the internet
summary: The source code for the 19-year-old Windows XP operating system has been leaked online, reportedly originating from 4Chan. This leak raises significant security concerns, as experts like Dr. Dennis Acuña and Dr. Helen Schneider warn that it makes Windows XP systems more vulnerable to attacks from "bad actors" who can now analyze the code for weaknesses. While Microsoft has a Government Security Program providing access to source code for national governments, this widespread public leak poses a new threat, particularly to older systems still in use.

title: Juniper Networks snaps up SD-WAN vendor 128 Technology for $450M
summary: Juniper Networks has announced its acquisition of SD-WAN vendor 128 Technology for $450 million. This acquisition aims to boost Juniper's presence in the enterprise SD-WAN market and integrate 128 Technology's "Session Smart" routing with Juniper's AI-driven enterprise network portfolio. The deal reflects ongoing consolidation within the SD-WAN sector, following similar acquisitions by Palo Alto Networks and HPE.

title: New Comcast Business Solution Powered by Aruba Brings Secure, Enterprise-grade Office Connectivity from Home
summary: Comcast Business, in partnership with Aruba, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise company, has launched the Comcast Business Teleworker VPN solution. This new offering aims to provide remote employees with secure, reliable, and high-performance connectivity to their corporate networks, mirroring their in-office experience. The solution addresses the challenges organizations face with remote work setups, security, and management, especially in light of the COVID-19 pandemic's acceleration of remote work trends.

title: Microsoft, MDEC and MaGIC to nurture Malaysia’s next tech unicorns
summary: Microsoft Malaysia, in partnership with MDEC and MaGIC, launched the "Highway to a 100 Unicorns" initiative to strengthen Malaysia's startup ecosystem. This program offers mentoring, technology, access to enterprise clients, and workshops to help local startups scale globally and potentially become unicorns. Startups can apply for the Emerge X competition, with finalists gaining year-long mentorship, a Founder Bootcamp, and global market access.

title: Verizon teams with Microsoft to offer private 5G mobile edge computing - Source
summary: Verizon and Microsoft are partnering to provide private 5G mobile edge computing solutions for enterprises, combining Verizon's on-site 5G Edge network with Microsoft Azure edge services. This collaboration aims to accelerate the delivery of fast and secure 5G applications, enabling ultra-low latency for real-time data analysis and enhancing applications in various industries. Ice Mobility is already utilizing this technology for quality control in their logistics operations, demonstrating significant improvements in processing time and accuracy.

title: 5 Big Questions
summary: This page on inside.lighting features a collection of "5 Big Questions" interviews with prominent figures in the lighting industry. The interviews cover a wide range of topics, including specific company strategies, industry trends, technological advancements like LED and control systems, and broader economic and social issues like diversity and regulatory changes. The aim is to provide insights from newsmakers, thought leaders, and executives within the lighting sector.

title: Elevating the Cloud Experience with Parallels® Desktop for HP’s Chrome Enterprise Portfolio
summary: HP has partnered with Google and Corel to introduce Parallels® Desktop for HP Chrome Enterprise, a solution enabling Chrome OS devices to run almost any Windows application. This enhanced feature allows users to seamlessly run legacy Windows applications and ERP software directly on their Intel Core processor-based Chrome OS devices, addressing limitations that previously restricted broader Chrome OS adoption in enterprises. The new functionality offers simple deployment, manageability via Google Admin console, and robust security, making it easier for companies to accelerate cloud-first IT strategies.

title: Microsoft and Elon Musk’s SpaceX partner to woo space customers
summary: Microsoft is expanding its cloud-computing platform into space by partnering with Elon Musk's SpaceX, connecting its Azure cloud to SpaceX's low-Earth orbiting satellites. This collaboration aims to give Microsoft an edge against rivals like Amazon and meet the increasing demand for data-heavy space services, such as disaster prediction and supply chain visibility. SpaceX hopes the revenue from its Starlink internet-beaming satellites will help fund its interplanetary goals and recently secured a $149 million Pentagon contract for missile-tracking satellites.

title: Database Case Studies with Cloud Volumes ONTAP
summary: This article showcases several case studies demonstrating how NetApp's Cloud Volumes ONTAP facilitates the migration and operation of various databases (SQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SAP HANA, Hadoop) in public cloud environments like AWS and Azure. Companies like Concerto Cloud, Mellanox, AdvancedMD, and Fujitsu achieved significant benefits such as reduced costs, improved data reduction, enhanced disaster recovery, and simplified data management by utilizing Cloud Volumes ONTAP for their cloud database strategies. The cases highlight the solution's ability to provide high availability, performance, and scalability across hybrid cloud architectures.

title: MongoDB Atlas now enables multi-cloud database clusters
summary: MongoDB has enhanced its Atlas cloud database service to support multi-cloud clusters, allowing databases to run simultaneously across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. This new capability addresses customer demand for data portability across different cloud providers, enabling features like live replication and proximity-based query routing for improved performance and compliance. The change shifts from running separate applications on different clouds to truly integrated, distributed databases across multiple cloud environments.

title: TSMC Announces 2020 OIP Partner of the Year Awards for Excellence in Accelerating Silicon Innovation
summary: TSMC recognized 10 EDA, IP, and Cloud Alliance partners with its 2020 OIP Partner of the Year awards for their outstanding contributions to accelerating silicon innovation and reducing time to market for IC designers. These partners demonstrated excellence in next-generation system-on-chip (SoC) and 3DIC design enablement, helping customers overcome design barriers and achieve first-time silicon success. The awards highlight the crucial role of ecosystem partners in supporting TSMC's latest technologies and advanced foundry solutions.

title: Microsoft announces plans to establish its first cloud region in Austria to accelerate local innovation and growth
summary: Microsoft announced plans to establish its first cloud datacenter region in Austria, aiming to accelerate local innovation and growth, and modernize the country's IT infrastructure. This investment is projected to generate up to $2.1 billion in new revenue for Austria's partner ecosystem over the next four years. Additionally, Microsoft will launch a Center of Digital Excellence and a skilling initiative targeting 120,000 Austrians by 2024.

title: Expedia aims for tech efficiency in long-term remote shift
summary: Expedia Group is focusing on tech efficiency to support its long-term remote work strategy, making changes that are intended to be permanent, not temporary. The company saw significant increases in internal communication tools like Slack and videoconferencing as its workforce shifted remotely. Expedia aims to ensure employees can be effective regardless of their location, recognizing that remote work has become a critical expectation for tech talent.

title: Bitcoin soars to new 2020 high on PayPal shift to crypto
summary: Bitcoin surged to a new 2020 high following PayPal's announcement that it would enable cryptocurrency use for its customers. This development is seen as a significant step towards wider acceptance of digital currencies, with other companies like Square Inc. and MicroStrategy Inc. also investing in Bitcoin. Mike Novogratz from Galaxy Investment Partners called it "the biggest news of the year in crypto," anticipating a race among banks to service digital currencies.

title: Nvidia’s A100 GPU sets new performance records in MLPerf benchmarks
summary: Nvidia's A100 GPU has set new performance records in the latest MLPerf benchmarks, dominating tests across six application areas for data center and edge computing systems. The A100 GPU significantly outperformed CPUs in image classification and recommender tests, demonstrating extreme cost efficiency benefits for AI inference. Nvidia's systems are also making an impact in various industries, including medical imaging, automotive, and financial services, and are integrated into powerful supercomputers.

title: Ecolab Partners With Water.org to Improve Access to Clean, Safe, Sustainable Water
summary: Ecolab has partnered with Water.org to improve access to clean, safe, and sustainable water for 100,000 people in at-risk watersheds in India. This collaboration aims to provide equitable access to water, sanitation, and hygiene solutions while contributing to positive recurring water benefits in high-stress river basins. The partnership aligns with Ecolab's 2030 Impact Goals and its involvement in the Water Resilience Coalition, emphasizing social responsibility and community well-being.

title: Microsoft’s 2020 Diversity & Inclusion report: A commitment to accelerate progress amidst global change
summary: Microsoft's 2020 Diversity and Inclusion report highlights progress and commitments amidst global challenges, focusing on employee pandemic response, addressing racial injustice, and investing in Allyship at Microsoft. The report notably includes data on employees with disabilities for the first time and an expanded look at global equal pay data. It emphasizes the company's continuous efforts to accelerate leadership and talent development while strengthening its culture of inclusion.

title: Hackathon 2020: As agile as always!
summary: UBS's annual Hackathon for 2020 moved to a fully remote format, enabling global participation from over 500 engineers across 11 locations. This shift to online collaboration provided a more inclusive and flexible environment, fostering a wide variety of innovative ideas and solutions from over 55 projects. Despite the virtual setting, the event maintained its energetic and non-hierarchical spirit, encouraging quick thinking and experimentation, and aiming to create impactful tools and platforms for the company.

title: Microsoft's SpaceX partnership sends Azure to the final frontier
summary: Microsoft has launched its Azure Space initiative, partnering with SpaceX to integrate Azure with low-orbiting satellites and introduce a new Azure Modular Datacenter (MDC). This move positions Microsoft to compete in the space and satellite segment of the IaaS market, particularly targeting telecommunications, government, and energy industries. The venture will put Microsoft head-to-head with AWS, which already has similar cloud-based space offerings, requiring both companies to address the persistent issue of latency in satellite communications.

title: AT&T Has The Most Disappointing Big Company Stock This Year
summary: AT&T Inc. (NYSE: T) has recorded the worst stock performance among large-cap companies this year, dropping 27% while the S&P 500 gained 7%. This decline is significant compared to top companies like Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, and Facebook, which have seen substantial gains. The company also reported a 5% fall in operating revenue and a 22% drop in EPS, coupled with massive long-term debt, despite an impressive dividend yield.

title: How to invest in the S&P 500 without betting hard on the ‘FAAMG’ stocks that are 20% of the index
summary: This article discusses how to invest in the S&P 500 without heavily relying on the "FAAMG" stocks (Facebook, Apple, Amazon.com, Microsoft, and Google/Alphabet), which represent a significant portion of the index's valuation. It suggests that when investing in a standard S&P 500 index fund, one is implicitly making a large bet on the continued success of these five tech giants. The article hints at an alternative strategy, specifically mentioning an "Equal-weight S&P 500 ETF," for investors looking to diversify away from the concentrated influence of FAAMG stocks within the S&P 500.

title: How to invest in the S&P 500 without betting hard on the ‘FAAMG’ stocks that are 20% of the index
summary: This article discusses a strategy for investing in the S&P 500 without being overly reliant on the performance of the dominant "FAAMG" stocks. It highlights that the FAAMG stocks (Facebook, Apple, Amazon.com, Microsoft, and Google/Alphabet) collectively represent about 20% of the S&P 500's valuation. The piece suggests that investing in an equal-weight S&P 500 ETF can mitigate the concentrated risk associated with these technology giants.

title: How to invest in the S&P 500 without betting hard on the ‘FAAMG’ stocks that are 20% of the index
summary: This article discusses a strategy to invest in the S&P 500 without being overly exposed to the "FAAMG" stocks (Facebook, Apple, Amazon.com, Microsoft, and Google/Alphabet) which collectively represent 20% of the index's valuation. It suggests that when investing in a typical S&P 500 index fund, one is inherently making a significant bet on the continued success of these five dominant companies. The piece broadly hints at an "equal-weight S&P 500 ETF" as a potential solution for investors seeking diversification away from these outsized positions.

title: What is the Brussels Effect, and what does it mean for global regulation?
summary: The article explores "The Brussels Effect," a concept coined by Anu Bradford, detailing how the European Union's regulations globalize due to its large market. It highlights the EU's role as a global regulatory power, its balanced approach to tech regulation, and how this effect impacts international business, Brexit, and the relationship between regulation and innovation.

title: BCG and Microsoft Collaborate to Launch BCG's Catalyst Cloud Solution on Azure, a New Scalable and Extensible Data Platform for the Bionic Corporation
summary: Boston Consulting Group (BCG) and Microsoft have partnered to launch BCG's Catalyst Cloud, a new scalable and extensible data platform built on Microsoft Azure. This SaaS-based solution combines BCG's digital expertise with Microsoft's cloud capabilities to help organizations leverage AI and advanced analytics for data management, strategy, and business processes. The platform aims to empower business decision-makers with insights to predict outcomes, accelerate decision-making, and improve operational efficiencies.

title: Microsoft Tunnel Makes Connecting to Corporate Apps Easier from Android and iOS
summary: Microsoft Tunnel is a new VPN gateway solution for Intune, announced at Ignite in September 2020, designed to make connecting to on-premises corporate resources easier from Android and iOS devices. Differentiating itself from existing VPN solutions, it integrates fully with Microsoft 365, supporting single sign-on and Azure Active Directory Conditional Access policies. The solution aims to be enterprise-ready with simple deployment, automatic updates, and an app for users, although always-on VPN is limited to Android due to iOS restrictions.

title: C3.ai, Microsoft, and Adobe combine forces to re-invent CRM with AI
summary: C3.ai, Microsoft, and Adobe announced the launch of C3 AI® CRM, an AI-first, industry-specific customer relationship management solution powered by Microsoft Dynamics 365 and integrated with Adobe Experience Cloud. This collaboration aims to redefine the CRM market by offering AI-enabled revenue forecasting, product forecasting, and customer churn prediction tailored for various industries. The C3 AI CRM is unique for its modern AI-first architecture, enabling real-time predictive insights across the entire revenue supply chain.

title: C3 AI, Microsoft & Adobe: Reinventing CRM with AI
summary: C3.ai, Microsoft Corp., and Adobe Inc. announced the launch of C3 AI CRM, an enterprise-class, AI-first customer relationship management solution. This new offering, powered by Microsoft Dynamics 365 and integrating Adobe Experience Cloud, is purpose-built for industries and designed to drive customer-facing operations with predictive business insights. The partners aim to reinvent the CRM market by providing industry-specific, AI-enabled solutions for various sectors globally.

title: Facebook, Google and Microsoft 'avoiding $3bn in tax in poorer nations'
summary: ActionAid estimates that Google, Facebook, and Microsoft are avoiding up to $2.8bn (£2.2bn) in tax revenue in developing nations, a sum that could significantly boost public services like healthcare and education. The charity is advocating for a new global tax system, ideally under the United Nations, requiring large corporations to pay a minimum tax rate based on their "real economic presence." This initiative highlights long-standing concerns about tech giants' tax contributions and their impact on global south countries, especially as these companies have seen soaring revenues during the pandemic.

title: WPP appoints Dr. Ya-Qin Zhang to the Board
summary: WPP announced the appointment of Dr. Ya-Qin Zhang as a Non-Executive Director to its Board, effective January 1, 2021. Dr. Zhang is a renowned technologist, scientist, and entrepreneur with previous leadership roles at Baidu Inc. and Microsoft, and he currently holds positions at Tsinghua University and various corporate boards. His extensive experience in technology, particularly in AI and global operations, is expected to bring valuable contributions to WPP's Board.

title: Infographic: Microsoft (MSFT) stock gains as Q1 earnings top expectations
summary: Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) reported higher-than-expected revenues and earnings for the first quarter of 2021, leading to a stock gain. The company's Q1 revenues reached $37.2 billion, a 12% increase year-over-year, with server products and cloud services revenue advancing by 22% and Azure revenue by 48%. Net income rose to $13.9 billion, or $1.82 per share, surpassing analyst estimates.

title: SAP shares dip by almost 21%, its biggest stock market slump since 1999
summary: SAP experienced a significant stock market drop of 21% on Monday, its largest slump since 1999, resulting in a $35 billion loss in valuation. This dip followed the company's revised profit and revenue forecasts due to the impact of pandemic-related lockdowns and a slower-than-expected recovery in demand. While software sales declined, SAP's cloud computing business showed strong growth, and the company expects to triple cloud growth by 2025, anticipating a gradual recovery for its other operations over the next couple of years.

title: Utilimaster is Road Ready with Velocity F2, Class 2 Walk-In Van
summary: Utilimaster, a business unit of The Shyft Group, has launched its new Velocity F2, a purpose-built Class 2 walk-in van designed to meet the increasing demand in e-commerce and delivery services. Built on a Ford Transit chassis, the Velocity F2 offers a balance of nimbleness, comfort, fuel efficiency, and cargo capacity. It provides benefits such as lower total cost of ownership, no commercial driver's license requirement for operation, and improved fuel economy, with production orders now being accepted.

title: Election, Stimulus, or Rising Infections — What’s Driving Market Volatility?
summary: The ProShares Ultra VIX Short-Term Futures ETF (UVXY) spiked significantly on October 26th due to increased stock market volatility. This surge was attributed to concerns over rising COVID-19 infections, stalled stimulus talks, and upcoming U.S. elections and mega-cap company earnings reports. The article explains how the VIX Index and UVXY function in measuring and leveraging market volatility.

title: Irish tech company Asavie acquired by Nasdaq-listed Akamai
summary: Irish technology company Asavie, a mobility and "internet of things" (IoT) solutions provider, has been acquired by Nasdaq-listed Akamai Technologies for an undisclosed sum. Asavie, which employs over 130 people and had revenues of €23.6 million last year, will see its solutions integrated into Akamai’s security and personalisation services product line. The acquisition is not expected to significantly impact Akamai’s 2020 financials.

title: Microsoft to establish its first datacenter region in Taiwan as a part of its “Reimagine Taiwan” initiative
summary: Microsoft announced plans to establish its first cloud datacenter region in Taiwan as part of its "Reimagine Taiwan" initiative. This significant investment includes providing digital skilling for over 200,000 people by 2024 and expanding Taiwan's Azure Hardware Systems and Infrastructure engineering group, positioning Taiwan as an innovation hub for cloud software and hardware. The initiative aims to accelerate digital transformation for public and private sectors, contribute over $10 billion in new revenue, and create more than 30,000 jobs in Taiwan over the next four years.

title: Time-of-flight technology promises enhanced accuracy
summary: Analog Devices (ADI) and Microsoft are collaborating to develop highly accurate time-of-flight (ToF) 3D imaging solutions, leveraging Microsoft's Azure Kinect technology and ADI's IC and system expertise. This partnership aims to simplify the adoption of ToF technology across various industries like Industry 4.0, automotive, gaming, and augmented reality, addressing challenges such as achieving millimeter-depth resolution and fine spatial resolution over varying temperatures. The goal is to bring advanced 3D sensing capabilities to a broad market, enabling applications ranging from human-collaboration robots to enhanced facial recognition and improved automotive safety.

title: Robust Growth Visible for Threat Intelligence Platform Market
summary: A new report forecasts robust growth for the global Threat Intelligence Platform Market from 2020 to 2025, driven by an increase in targeted attacks, advanced persistent threats, and stringent data protection regulations. North America is currently the largest revenue-generating region, with Asia-Pacific expected to show significant growth. Key players in this market include IBM, Symantec, FireEye, and McAfee, among others.

title: New Lenovo and Intel Study: Empowering Employees Through Technology Can Supercharge Returns
summary: A new study by Lenovo and Intel, conducted by Forrester Consulting, reveals that investing in employee technology yields a 5x return through improved productivity, agility, and customer satisfaction. The study highlights a disconnect between IT decision-makers and employees regarding technology priorities, with employees often feeling their devices are outdated while IT focuses on strategic integration. It recommends that companies prioritize employee feedback and invest in fundamental tools like PCs to boost engagement and business outcomes.

title: Rackspace Technology opens new Singapore office
summary: Rackspace Technology has opened a new 4,876-square-foot office in Singapore's Central Business District, quadrupling its previous office size and anticipating a 25% increase in headcount. This expansion is part of the company's continued investment in the APAC region and its strategy to enhance digitization plans for businesses globally, especially for its cloud solutions following its IPO. The new office will serve as a base for expansion into ASEAN markets, focusing on helping businesses leverage cloud technology for efficiency, productivity, and cost optimization.

title: Walgreens Boots Alliance Renews and Extends Relationship with WPP to Accelerate Digital Transformation and Deep Focus on Communications
summary: Walgreens Boots Alliance (WBA) has renewed and extended its partnership with WPP as its global marketing and communications agency until at least the end of 2022, with an option to extend further. This collaboration aims to accelerate WBA's digital transformation, focusing on implementing an integrated mass-personalization marketing strategy and reputation-management communications. The partnership will leverage data and technology solutions, including WBA's strategic alliance with Microsoft and Adobe, to create personalized omnichannel experiences.

title: Microsoft and NSDC collaborate to empower 1 lakh underserved young women across India with digital skills
summary: Microsoft and the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) have partnered to provide digital skills training to over 1 lakh underserved young women across India within the next 10 months. This initiative aims to enhance employability and address the gender gap in digital skills, particularly for first-time job seekers and those affected by COVID-19. The program will offer more than 70 hours of free course content on digital literacy, entrepreneurship, and communication skills, delivered online through the Microsoft Community Training platform.

title: Domain Parking: A Gateway to Attackers Spreading Emotet and Impersonating McAfee
summary: This article by Palo Alto Networks' Unit 42 details how domain parking services are abused by attackers to spread malware, engage in phishing, and run other malicious campaigns. Over a seven-month period in 2020, 1.0% of transitioned parked domains changed to malicious categories, an eight times higher rate than benign domains. The authors highlight specific cases of Emotet distribution through domain registration abuse, advertisement abuse leading to exploit kits and survey scams during the U.S. election, and typosquatting to impersonate McAfee for ad revenue.

title: ARK Invest's Cathie Wood Reveals Her Successful Playbook
summary: Cathie Wood, founder and CEO of ARK Invest, shares her "playbook" for success, emphasizing thinking big, focusing on innovation, and embracing disruption. Her firm's impressive growth and the performance of its ARK Innovation ETF (ARKK) demonstrate the effectiveness of her approach, which includes conviction in ideas, continuous brainstorming, curiosity, and collaboration with innovators. Wood also highlights the importance of making your own opportunities and the value of mentorship.

title: China’s Industrial Supply Platform ZKH Nets $315 Million
summary: Chinese industrial products e-commerce platform ZKH Industrial Supply Co. Ltd. has raised $315 million in a Series E financing round, primarily led by YF Capital and significant state-owned investors. This latest funding brings ZKH's total raised capital to over $671 million, making it the largest funding round in the industrial products sector. The capital will be used to enhance products, services, technology, and supply chain capacity, further developing its B2B platform that provides industrial distribution and MRO solutions.

title: Amazon cloud revenue jumps 29%, in line with expectations
summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) saw a 29% increase in revenue in the third quarter of 2020, reaching $11.60 billion, which was slightly below estimates. Despite this, AWS operating income jumped 56% to $3.54 billion, exceeding expectations and contributing significantly to Amazon's overall operating income. The growth was attributed to continued demand for cloud services during the pandemic, although other Amazon business segments grew faster this quarter.

title: Geojit Financial Services launches AI-powered global investment platform
summary: Geojit Financial Services has launched an AI-powered global investment platform in partnership with Stockal, a New York-based wealth management services platform. This new platform allows Indian investors to diversify their portfolios by investing in global equities, starting with US stocks and ETFs. The initiative aims to cater to the growing interest among domestic investors, high-net-worth individuals, and expatriates in global asset classes.

title: AMD’s Lisa Su challenges Intel with record Xilinx deal
summary: AMD CEO Lisa Su has announced a US$35 billion all-stock acquisition of Xilinx Inc, marking one of the largest chip deals ever and a direct challenge to Intel's dominance. This strategic move aims to expand AMD into new markets like automotive and communications networking, bolstering its offerings in cloud data centers. The acquisition will significantly increase AMD's research and development budget, positioning the company for future technical leadership, building on Su's successful turnaround of AMD since 2014.

title: Gartner Survey Reveals 47% of Organizations Will Increase Investments in IoT Despite the Impact of COVID-19
summary: A Gartner survey indicates that 47% of organizations plan to increase their investments in the Internet of Things (IoT) despite the COVID-19 pandemic, with cost reduction being a primary driver. The survey also highlights the growing adoption of digital twins and AI in conjunction with IoT, particularly for improving safety and operational efficiency. By 2023, Gartner expects a significant portion of companies implementing IoT to also integrate AI into at least one IoT project.

title: Microsoft named a Leader in the Gartner 2020 Magic Quadrant for Industrial IoT Platforms
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner 2020 Magic Quadrant for Industrial IoT Platforms, highlighting its vision and capabilities alongside key partners like Hitachi and PTC. The report underscores the acceleration of digital transformation in IIoT due to recent disruptions, with companies focusing on efficiency and integrating AI and edge computing. IoT Signals Edition 2 research shows two out of three organizations plan to increase IoT usage, with efficiency as the primary driver for adoption in manufacturing, despite complexity and talent challenges.

title: Marvell to buy Inphi in $10bn semiconductor deal
summary: Semiconductor company Marvell Technology Group is set to acquire Inphi Corp in a $10 billion cash-and-stock deal. The acquisition aims to strengthen Marvell's leadership in cloud infrastructure and expand its 5G presence, leveraging Inphi's expertise in fiber-optic data traffic and its customer base including Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Facebook. This move is part of a broader trend of consolidation within the semiconductor industry.

title: COVID recasts local landscape for game developers
summary: The COVID-19 pandemic is significantly reshaping Vancouver's video game industry, pushing companies to adapt to remote work and a more flexible approach to talent acquisition. According to Wil Mozell, CEO of Sun Machine Games, this shift necessitates that Vancouver-based companies leverage their tech strengths and adopt new operational models where talent can be located anywhere, rather than relying on in-office presence. The industry will increasingly focus on cohesive product development and efficiency rather than just the number of employees.

title: Technology Upgrade Solutions for SMB Efficiency
summary: This article emphasizes that upgrading technology is a cost-effective way for SMBs to boost efficiency, referencing insights from IT expert Rob Poulin. Key recommendations include prioritizing broadband upgrades, investing in new hardware rather than just software upgrades, adopting cloud computing, modernizing POS systems, and optimizing online presence, all within a structured upgrade schedule. The article highlights the significant return on investment from these technological improvements.

title: Analysis: In an epic pivot to the cloud, Microsoft makes Azure the linchpin of its future
summary: Microsoft's Azure cloud computing service is a central component of the company's innovation strategy, driving significant revenue growth and serving as a key differentiator from competitors focused on advertising. The company's overall financial performance is strong, with impressive growth across its three main business segments: Productivity and Business Process, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Microsoft's successful pivot to the cloud and its developer-centric approach have made it a leader in the tech industry, demonstrating remarkable spending momentum among its customers despite its large size.

title: Shell.ai Wins Constellation Research SuperNova Award for Predictive Analytics
summary: Shell.ai, led by General Manager of Data Science Dan Jeavons, has won the Constellation Research SuperNova Award for "Data to Decisions" for its use of big data and predictive analytics. The company's program, supported by technology partners C3.ai and Microsoft, was recognized for its ambition, scale in embedding AI, and successful transformation from pilot projects to production-scale AI applications. Shell.ai utilizes the C3 AI® Suite and Azure Data Lake Storage to process vast amounts of time-series data, aiming to achieve "Zero Trips by 2025."

title: Law-Firm Clients Demand More Black Attorneys
summary: Corporate clients such as Microsoft, Uber, and U.S. Bancorp are increasingly pressuring the law firms they hire to demonstrate a commitment to diversity, specifically in employing and utilizing Black attorneys. This pressure comes after years of law firms promising to improve diversity, with companies now demanding action and transparency regarding the representation of Black lawyers in their legal teams and the meaningfulness of their assignments. Firms that fail to meet these expectations could face consequences such as lost bonuses or not being hired for future work.

title: Tencent leads US$50mn investment in communications developer Zego
summary: Tencent Holdings has led a US$50 million investment round in real-time communications software developer Zego, highlighting the growing interest in online education and videoconferencing post-pandemic. Zego, founded by former QQ head Lin Youyao, competes in the burgeoning enterprise software sector and has been profitable since 2016, providing tech solutions to over 1,000 customers. The global communications platform-as-a-service market is projected to reach over US$17 billion by 2023.

title: Technology Upgrade Solutions for SMB Efficiency
summary: Outdated technology costs U.S. businesses billions annually. This article, featuring insights from IT expert Rob Poulin, outlines key tech upgrade solutions for SMBs to boost efficiency and save money. The recommendations include prioritizing broadband upgrades, acquiring new hardware over software upgrades, switching to cloud computing, modernizing POS systems, and optimizing online presence, all structured around a regular technology upgrade schedule.

title: IndianoriginCEOs
summary: This article highlights 13 individuals of Indian origin who hold significant leadership positions in global IT companies. It showcases their roles, companies, and key achievements, underscoring the growing presence and influence of Indian-origin executives in the international tech industry.

title: UPS Announces Changes To Board Of Directors
summary: UPS has announced the election of Kate Johnson, President, Microsoft US, and Russell Stokes, President & CEO of GE Aviation Services, to its Board of Directors. Concurrently, John Stankey is departing the board to concentrate on his role as CEO of AT&T Inc. These changes aim to enhance the board's governance and introduce diverse experiences, leading to 40% female and 25% ethnically diverse representation on the board.

title: GameStop, Klarna team up on installment payments
summary: Klarna has partnered with GameStop to offer interest-free installment payments for in-store, mobile, and online purchases. This collaboration seeks to provide more service options for GameStop customers, especially leading into the holiday season, capitalizing on the increased interest in gaming during the pandemic. GameStop joins other major retailers like Macy's and Google in adopting Klarna's alternative payment platform.

title: Microsoft trials last-mile content delivery technology to drive reach in remote geographies
summary: Microsoft is piloting a new last-mile content delivery technology in collaboration with Eros Now to bring rich visual content to consumers in low-bandwidth regions of India. This initiative leverages Microsoft Azure and aims to bridge the digital divide by allowing users to download media content to their mobile devices without continuous internet connectivity. The successful pilot program is set to expand, helping media partners reach more customers and enabling inclusive growth through technology access.

title: 7 Hacks to Free Up Space on Your Hard Drive
summary: This article provides seven tips to free up space on a computer's hard drive and improve performance. It covers uninstalling unused apps, cleaning the desktop, deleting large files, using the Disk Cleanup Tool, removing temporary files, managing downloads, and saving to the cloud. The article emphasizes that regular maintenance is crucial for optimal computer performance.

title: Rockwell Automation Unveils New Capabilities in FactoryTalk(R) InnovationSuite(TM), Powered by PTC, to Accelerate Digital Transformation
summary: Rockwell Automation announced new capabilities for FactoryTalk InnovationSuite, powered by PTC, to accelerate digital transformation for industrial organizations. These enhancements automate IT/OT integration, simplify edge-to-cloud analytics, create a scalable digital thread, and introduce consulting and delivery services. The collaboration with PTC aims to optimize people, products, and processes for manufacturers responding to macroeconomic changes.

title: Cloud-Based Project Portfolio Management Market | Increasing Requirement for Large Scale Project Management to Boost Growth | Technavio
summary: The global cloud-based project portfolio management market is projected to grow by USD 3.86 billion during 2020-2024, at a CAGR of almost 17%. The growth is driven by increasing requirements for large-scale project management, despite challenges like high implementation and operating costs. The report analyzes market leaders, competitive landscapes, and the impact of COVID-19 on the industry.

title: ITSMA study: Earning B2B buyer trust matters even more now
summary: A recent ITSMA study, co-sponsored by Adobe and SAP, highlights that earning B2B buyer trust is more crucial than ever, especially in light of the COVID-19 pandemic. The survey of nearly 300 B2B senior executives reveals that technology providers, professional services firms, and systems integrators are top sources of trusted information. Digital transformation has become a primary driver for technology investments, with cloud, security, and collaboration software being key priorities, while content quality and practical insights are preferred over format.

title: WPP Integrates India-Based Creative Agency The Glitch Into VMLY&R
summary: WPP has integrated its Indian creative agency, The Glitch, with VMLY&R, its global experience agency, as part of an ongoing consolidation strategy. This move aims to leverage the strengths of both agencies to create a stronger offering by combining technology and creative expertise. The Glitch will become part of the VMLY&R network, with its senior leaders reporting to VMLY&R Asia's Co-CEO and forming an India leadership council to manage strategic decisions.

title: PUBG Mobile plots return to India with Microsoft deal
summary: PUBG Mobile, banned in India two months prior due to cybersecurity concerns, is planning a return to the Indian market. The South Korean firm, Krafton, has partnered with Microsoft to host games like PUBG Mobile on Microsoft Azure, aiming to ensure personal data protection and comply with India's data residency requirements. The company is expected to make an announcement and intends to resume service in India before the end of the year.

title: Udacity Secures $75 Mn to Continue Momentum
summary: Udacity announced significant growth in Q3 bookings and ARR for H1 2020, reaching profitability. To sustain this momentum, the company secured a $75 million debt facility from Hercules Capital (NYSE: HTGC). This funding will support Udacity's continued expansion in providing technology skills training to individuals, enterprises, and governments globally.

title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Shares What He’s Learned About Stakeholder Capitalism As the Head of America’s Most JUST Company
summary: Satya Nadella discusses Microsoft's commitment to stakeholder capitalism, emphasizing that a corporation's purpose extends beyond profit to finding solutions for societal and planetary issues. He highlights Microsoft's environmental leadership and the importance of supporting democracy, asserting that shareholders also desire a stakeholder-focused approach. Nadella believes that grounding decisions in purpose, especially during challenging times, leads to greater resiliency and long-term success.

title: Nokia Stock Remains a Deep-Value Investor’s Delight
summary: Despite losing a significant contract to Samsung, Nokia is still seen as a strong investment for deep-value investors due to its robust 5G contracts in other regions and its strong financial position. The company's new CEO, Pekka Lundmark, is praised for his efforts to improve Nokia's 5G standing, and the stock is considered undervalued compared to its rivals. Nokia's progress in securing new partnerships and its healthy cash flow suggest a potential reinstatement of dividends.

title: Windows XP, Server 2003 Source Code Leak Leaves IoT, OT Devices Vulnerable
summary: The source code for Windows XP and Windows Server 2003 was leaked, making broadly available vulnerabilities for which no software fixes exist. This is a critical issue for IoT and OT devices, particularly in healthcare, where many devices still run these end-of-life operating systems. Upgrading these systems is challenging due to administrative, operational, and cost-related issues, leaving them highly vulnerable to attack.

title: PUBG is Coming to Microsoft Azure
summary: Microsoft and Krafton announced that PLAYERUNKNOWN’S BATTLEGROUNDS (PUBG) and PUBG Mobile will be hosted on Microsoft Azure. Krafton, PUBG Corporation's parent company, chose Azure for its robust personal data protection and compliance offerings. The collaboration will also establish a verification process to ensure player information storage meets regulatory standards.

title: Wayside Technology Acquires CDF Group
summary: Wayside Technology Group's subsidiary, Climb Channel Solutions, has acquired CDF Group Limited, a UK-based cloud, software, and IT distributor and services provider. This strategic acquisition is intended to accelerate Climb's cloud marketplace position and expand its footprint in EMEA, leveraging CDF's cloud services platform and Microsoft Gold Partner status. The integration is expected to offer cross-sell opportunities for existing U.S. and Canadian customers and enhance Climb's value-added services.

title: RDP and the remote desktop
summary: This article discusses the security concerns surrounding Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) in the context of remote work, highlighting its vulnerability to attacks like brute-force attempts and remote code execution exploits such as BlueKeep. It presents data on RDP's prevalence among open TCP ports and the frequency of BlueKeep-related alerts, emphasizing that a significant percentage of organizations face these threats. The article concludes with recommendations for securing RDP, including using VPNs, strong authentication, and changing default ports, or exploring alternative remote access solutions.

title: ManpowerGroup Elects Jean-Philippe Courtois and William P Gipson to Board of Directors
summary: ManpowerGroup announced the election of Jean-Philippe Courtois, EVP of Microsoft, and William P. Gipson, a retired Procter & Gamble executive, to its Board of Directors, effective December 14, 2020. Courtois brings expertise in digital transformation and technology's societal impact, while Gipson offers a strong background in business transformation, innovation, and diversity and inclusion. These appointments are expected to support ManpowerGroup's strategic priorities, including digitization and innovation.

title: Prisma Access: SASE Architected for Unprecedented Security and Scale
summary: Palo Alto Networks' Prisma Access service, combined with CloudGenix SD-WAN, offers a comprehensive SASE platform designed for unprecedented security and scale. Leveraging cloud-native architecture on AWS and Google Cloud, it provides extensive global coverage and ultra-fast security processing, proven by its ability to support massive increases in remote workers during the COVID-19 pandemic. The service has demonstrated rapid scalability, enabling major organizations like PwC, Schlumberger, and Flex to transition significant portions of their workforce to remote operations without disruption.

title: How Upwork's First Female CEO Is Pivoting The Freelancing Business For A Remote World
summary: Hayden Brown, Upwork's first female CEO, navigated the company through the pandemic, witnessing its stock surge by 70% year-to-date and a 50% increase in freelancer and corporate registrants, with revenue projected to reach $365 million in 2020. She has focused on catering to larger clients for long-term projects, differentiating Upwork from competitors amidst a growing remote work trend. Brown attributes the company's success to the accelerated adoption of remote work by companies due to the pandemic and aims to capitalize on this shift in long-term views on remote work.

title: PUBG Mobile could return to India on Microsoft's Azure cloud services
summary: PUBG Mobile, previously banned in India due to its Chinese publisher Tencent, might return to the country through Microsoft's Azure cloud services. This move aims to circumvent data collection issues that led to the ban, as PUBG's parent company, Krafton Inc., has signed a deal with Microsoft to run the game on Azure. The PUBG Corporation hopes this technical solution and Microsoft's goodwill will satisfy the Indian government's concerns about data privacy.

title: Apple's new Macs could revive the PC chip wars, benefit Qualcomm: Analysts
summary: Apple is expected to unveil new Mac computers using its own in-house Arm-based processor chips, a move that could disrupt the PC chip market currently dominated by Intel and AMD. This shift could benefit companies like Qualcomm, which has been developing Arm-based processors for Windows PCs. Analysts suggest that Apple's entry into this market could accelerate the adoption of Arm-based PCs, despite challenges related to software compatibility.

title: Apple launches MacBook laptops powered by its own computing chips
summary: Apple has introduced new MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, and Mac Mini models, marking a significant shift to its in-house designed M1 central processor, moving away from Intel technology. This move aims to technologically integrate Apple's computers and iPhones more closely, enhance battery life, and encourage developers to create universal apps for both platforms. The company anticipates cost savings and improved performance for its Mac lineup.

title: Check Point CloudGuard integrates with AWS Gateway Load Balancer at Launch
summary: Check Point CloudGuard has integrated with the newly launched AWS Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) to enhance cloud security for AWS customers. This integration allows for simplified deployment, scaling, and management of virtual network appliances like CloudGuard security gateways within AWS, ensuring high availability and advanced threat prevention. The article explains how GWLB works with CloudGuard to provide transparent traffic inspection, reduced network complexity, and consistent security policies across hybrid cloud environments.

title: Microsoft and the Open Data Institute announce an Education Open Data Challenge to help close the digital divide
summary: Microsoft and the Open Data Institute (ODI) have launched an Education Open Data Challenge to investigate the link between broadband access and K-12 education outcomes, especially in light of the COVID-19 pandemic's impact on remote learning. The challenge encourages participants to develop innovative solutions to bridge the digital divide in education, with prize money for non-profit organizations chosen by the winning teams. Participants will gain access to unique datasets, tools, and mentorship to help address how digital infrastructure gaps affect educational delivery and learning outcomes for students globally.

title: Apple’s New MacBooks (and Mac Mini) Are Powered By iPhone DNA
summary: Apple announced new Mac desktop and laptop computers powered by its homemade M1 chip, an ARM-based design similar to those found in iPhones and iPads. This marks a significant shift from Intel processors, promising benefits like improved battery life, graphics, and machine learning capabilities, along with compatibility for iOS and iPadOS apps. The initial models include new MacBook Air ($999), MacBook Pro ($1,299), and Mac Mini ($699) offerings.

title: Former McAfee CEO Chris Young joins Microsoft
summary: Chris Young, former CEO of McAfee Corp., has joined Microsoft Corp. to lead business development. Young previously oversaw McAfee's spinout from Intel Corp. and is now taking on a new executive role.

title: SentinelOne Announces $267M Series F
summary: SentinelOne has announced a $267 million Series F funding round, led by Tiger Global Management, which has propelled its valuation to over $3 billion. This significant investment will enable the company to accelerate the development of its Singularity XDR Platform, a leading solution for comprehensive enterprise protection. The company has experienced rapid growth, with its valuation tripling since its Series E funding in February 2020, driven by the increasing global demand for cloud-native autonomous cybersecurity platforms.

title: Workday Named a Leader in the 2020 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud HCM Suites for 1,000+ Employee Enterprises
summary: Workday has been recognized as a Leader in the 2020 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud HCM Suites for 1,000+ Employee Enterprises for the fifth consecutive year, achieving the highest position for its ability to execute. This recognition highlights Workday's commitment to innovation, particularly in machine learning and skills-fueled capabilities, which enable customers to adapt to rapid changes and optimize their workforces. The company's expanding ecosystem, strong customer satisfaction, and investments in analytics like Workday People Analytics and VIBE Index™ demonstrate its leadership in providing comprehensive, agile HR solutions.

title: How Microsoft and Sony’s new consoles improve game technology
summary: Penn professors and lecturers discuss the technological advancements in the new PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X consoles. Key improvements include solid-state hard drives (SSDs) for faster loading times and hardware-based ray tracing for photo-realistic graphics. The article also touches on the potential impact of streaming services on the gaming industry.

title: The Snowflake Story
summary: Snowflake Inc., founded in 2012, is a cloud-based data-warehousing company that came out of stealth mode in 2014. The company offers a data warehouse-as-a-service, running on major cloud platforms and enabling data storage and analytics for corporate users. Snowflake had a historic IPO on September 16, 2020, with shares more than doubling in value, leading to a $70.4 billion market valuation on its first day of trading.

title: Amazon shifts some voice assistant, face recognition computing to its own chips
summary: Amazon is transitioning some of the computing for its Alexa voice assistant and Rekognition facial recognition service to its custom-designed "Inferentia" chips. This strategic move aims to improve speed and reduce costs by moving away from third-party chip providers like Nvidia. The company reports a 25% improvement in latency and 30% lower costs for Alexa's text-to-speech tasks with the new chips.

title: 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader
summary: Oracle has been recognized as a Leader for the tenth consecutive year in Gartner's 2025 Magic Quadrant for Cloud HCM Suites for 1000+ Employee Enterprises. The company was also positioned furthest to the right on the Completeness of Vision axis for the eighth year in a row, with their Senior Vice President, Yvette Cameron, highlighting their advancements in AI, recruitment, skills management, employee experience, and workforce management. Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM offers a comprehensive cloud solution that integrates all human resource processes.

title: Why Google, Amazon, and Nvidia are all building AI notetakers for doctors
summary: Google, Amazon, and Nvidia are developing AI-powered notetaking tools for doctors to address the time-consuming and often inaccurate process of medical transcription. These tools aim to improve the efficiency and accuracy of recording patient interactions and medical records, moving beyond existing methods that doctors find cumbersome or overly generalized. While some solutions are already available, tech giants are focusing on delivering more precise and sophisticated AI to streamline healthcare documentation.

title: Cisco CEO Chuck Robbins on Q1 earnings, remote work, outlook and more
summary: Cisco Systems Inc. reported strong fiscal first-quarter net income of $2.17 billion, surpassing analyst expectations. CEO Chuck Robbins discussed these earnings, the company's future outlook, and the impact of remote work during an interview on "Squawk on the Street." His comments address the company's performance and strategy amidst the ongoing pandemic.

title: What's Changed: 2020 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud HCM Suites for 1,000+ Employee Enterprises
summary: This article analyzes the 2020 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud HCM Suites for 1,000+ Employee Enterprises, highlighting changes from the previous year. It discusses the evolving landscape of HCM solutions, emphasizing user experience (UX) and the integration of new technologies like chatbots. The report evaluates 11 providers, identifying leaders such as Workday, Oracle, UKG (Ultimate Software and Kronos), and SAP, while also detailing the positions of niche players and market trends.

title: Walgreens Boots Alliance boosts customer service with chatbots built on Microsoft Azure
summary: Walgreens Boots Alliance (WBA) implemented Microsoft Azure-based chatbots to enhance customer service on its Walgreens.com and Boots.com websites, a plan expedited by the COVID-19 pandemic. WBA deployed a COVID-19 Risk Assessment bot using Microsoft Healthcare Bot service and a general Q&A bot using Microsoft Bot Framework, allowing customers to get quick answers and streamlining healthcare interactions. This initiative has improved customer experience and strengthened WBA's partnerships with telemedicine providers.

title: VF Corp. invests in empathy and resources for working parents
summary: VF Corp. has invested in empathy and resources for its working parents, recognizing the increased challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic. The company launched initiatives like "Laptops for Learning," Rethink for special needs children, and "Guidance Now" for tutoring and childcare assistance. They also expanded elder care support and implemented flexible work schedules to support employees' work-life balance.

title: Video game prices to increase for the first time in 15 years
summary: Video game publishers are set to increase the standard price of new games to $70, coinciding with the launch of new consoles from Microsoft Corp. and Sony Corp., marking the first significant price hike in 15 years. This move is justified by inflation and the rising costs of developing "triple-A" games, despite potential consumer backlash amplified by the current economic crisis. The article discusses historical game pricing, consumer reactions, and alternative business models like subscription services, referencing companies such as Nintendo Co., Take-Two Interactive Software Inc., and Electronics Arts Inc.

title: Reshape the future of work with Microsoft Dataverse for Teams—now generally available
summary: Microsoft has announced the general availability of Dataverse for Teams, reflecting a strategic move to empower organizations with low-code data solutions. This renaming from Common Data Service to Microsoft Dataverse emphasizes its role as a secure and sophisticated backbone for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, enabling rapid app development and business process innovation. The initiative aims to broaden awareness of Dataverse's capabilities to individuals and organizations globally.

title: Data Privacy Laws and Compliance in the Education Industry
summary: The education industry is facing stricter data privacy requirements due to the global shift towards digitized learning and new data protection laws. This article clarifies key data privacy concepts and details the implications of significant laws like FERPA, GDPR, and CCPA on data collection, privacy notices, security, and data transfers in the education sector. It also highlights NetApp Cloud Compliance as a tool to help institutions manage and respond to data privacy requests.

title: NVIDIA Announces Mellanox InfiniBand for Exascale AI Supercomputing
summary: NVIDIA is introducing the next generation of NVIDIA Mellanox 400G InfiniBand, offering faster networking performance for AI developers and scientific researchers. This new technology provides ultra-low latency, double data throughput, and new In-Network Computing engines for enhanced acceleration, vital for fields like drug discovery and climate research. Leading infrastructure manufacturers and storage partners are integrating this technology into their solutions, aiming to tackle the most challenging computing problems with unmatched performance and efficiency.

title: 115 Amazon lobbyists. 1 works on climate
summary: Despite Amazon's public stance on climate action and its "Climate Pledge," an analysis reveals that only one out of its 115 lobbyists is focused on environmental issues. This raises questions about the company's commitment, with critics suggesting it may be "greenwashing." Other tech giants like Facebook also show similar discrepancies, while Microsoft, Apple, and Google appear to align their lobbying efforts more closely with their climate concerns.

title: Infographic: Gaming industry revenues grow 8.3% worldwide, pandemic accelerating upward trend
summary: The gaming industry is experiencing significant growth, with global revenues forecast to increase by 8.3% to $178.2 billion in 2021. This upward trend has been accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to increased spending by gamers, especially in mobile gaming. The industry is also proving to be crisis-resistant, with gaming shares performing well on the stock exchange.

title: Microsoft reveals Pluton, a custom security chip built into Intel, AMD and Qualcomm processors
summary: Microsoft has announced Pluton, a new security chip developed in partnership with Intel, AMD, and Qualcomm. This chip aims to enhance security by acting as a hardware root-of-trust, protecting devices from tampering and hardware attacks by integrating directly into future CPUs. Drawing lessons from its use in Xbox One and Azure Sphere, Pluton is designed to make it significantly harder for hackers to exploit physical access to extract sensitive data and will also help keep device firmware up-to-date.
